name: CubicJordan.jordan_of_cubic_trace_identity
statement:
theorem jordan_of_cubic_trace_identity
    (mul : V →ₗ[ℚ] V →ₗ[ℚ] V) (T : V →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (e : V)
    (comm : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x)
    (unit : ∀ x, mul e x = x)
    (assocTrace : ∀ x y z, T (mul (mul x y) z) = T (mul x (mul y z)))
    (char : ∀ x, residual mul T e x = 0) (x y : V) :
    mul (mul x y) (mul x x) = mul x (mul y (mul x x))

    (assocTrace : ∀ x y z, T (mul (mul x y) z) = T (mul x (mul y z)))
    (char : ∀ x, residual mul T e x = 0) (x y : V) :
    linearResidual mul T e x y = 0

name: AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.TrialityTensorCompositionTheorem
statement:
theorem TrialityTensorCompositionTheorem (alpha beta : K) :
    (∀ (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      triality v s c =
        v.r * evalU s.phi c.q
          + v.z * evalU c.psi s.p
          + BW v.omega (wedge2 s.p c.q)
          + pairW v.omega (dualWedge2 s.phi c.psi)) ∧
    (∀ (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      muV alpha beta s c =
        { r := evalU c.psi s.p
          z := evalU s.phi c.q
          omega := alpha • wedge2 s.p c.q
            + beta • hodgeStar (dualWedge2 s.phi c.psi) }) ∧
    (∀ (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      nV (muV alpha beta s c) =
        alpha * beta * evalU s.phi s.p * evalU c.psi c.q
          + (1 - alpha * beta) * evalU c.psi s.p * evalU s.phi c.q) ∧
    ((∀ (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      nV (muV alpha beta s c) = nS s * nC c) ↔ alpha * beta = 1)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.StructuredSourceCubicTheorem
statement:
theorem StructuredSourceCubicTheorem :
    sourceTrace (sourceOne : JCoord K) = 3 ∧
    sourceSpur (sourceOne : JCoord K) = 3 ∧
    sourceNorm (sourceOne : JCoord K) = 1 ∧
    (∀ (a : K) (x : JCoord K), sourceNorm (a • x) = a ^ 3 * sourceNorm x) ∧
    (∀ x y : JCoord K,
      sourceTraceForm x y =
        x.d1 * y.d1 + x.d2 * y.d2 + x.d3 * y.d3
          + BV x.v y.v + BS x.s y.s + BC x.c y.c) ∧
    (∀ x : JCoord K, (∀ y : JCoord K, sourceTraceForm x y = 0) → x = 0) ∧
    (∀ d1 d2 d3 : K,
      sourceTrace (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 + d2 + d3 ∧
      sourceSpur (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 * d2 + d1 * d3 + d2 * d3 ∧
      sourceNorm (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 * d2 * d3) ∧
    (∀ (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      sourceTrace (offDiagonal v s c) = 0 ∧
      sourceSpur (offDiagonal v s c) = -nV v - nS s - nC c ∧
      sourceNorm (offDiagonal v s c) = triality v s c)

theorem StructuredSourceProductTheorem :
    (∀ x : JCoord K, sourceProduct sourceOne x = x) ∧
    (∀ x : JCoord K, sourceProduct x sourceOne = x) ∧
    (∀ x y : JCoord K, sourceProduct x y = sourceProduct y x) ∧
    (∀ x₁ x₂ y : JCoord K,
      sourceProduct (x₁ + x₂) y = sourceProduct x₁ y + sourceProduct x₂ y) ∧
    (∀ (a : K) (x y : JCoord K),
      sourceProduct (a • x) y = a • sourceProduct x y)

    (∀ x : JCoord K,
      sourceTrace x = f0TraceK (structuredEquivK K x) ∧
      sourceSpur x = f0SpurK (structuredEquivK K x) ∧
      sourceNorm x = f0NormK (structuredEquivK K x)) ∧
    (∀ x y z : JCoord K,
      sourcePolar x y z =
        f0PolarK (structuredEquivK K x) (structuredEquivK K y)
          (structuredEquivK K z)) ∧
    (∀ x y : JCoord K,
      sourceTraceForm x y =
        f0TraceFormK (structuredEquivK K x) (structuredEquivK K y))

        { d1 := x.d1 ^ 2 + nS x.s + nC x.c
          d2 := x.d2 ^ 2 + nC x.c + nV x.v
          d3 := x.d3 ^ 2 + nV x.v + nS x.s
          v := (x.d2 + x.d3) • x.v + normalizedMuV x.s x.c
          s := (x.d1 + x.d3) • x.s + sourceMuS x.c x.v
          c := (x.d1 + x.d2) • x.c + sourceMuC x.v x.s }) ∧
    (∀ M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K, exteriorQ Mᵀ = exteriorQ M) ∧
    (∀ (alpha beta : K), alpha * beta = 1 →
      ∀ (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K),
        uV alpha beta s1 s2 c1 c2 =
          exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2)
            - alpha ^ 2 * deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2
            - beta ^ 2 * deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2) ∧
    (∀ (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K),
      normalizedUV s1 s2 c1 c2 =
        exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2)
          - deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2 - deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2)

theorem uV_of_mul_eq_one {alpha beta : K} (h : alpha * beta = 1)
    (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K) :
    uV alpha beta s1 s2 c1 c2 =
      exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2)
        - alpha ^ 2 * deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2
        - beta ^ 2 * deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2

name: AlbertLean.Residual.TrialitySquares.uV_parameterized_expansion
statement:
theorem uV_parameterized_expansion (alpha beta : K)
    (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K) :
    uV alpha beta s1 s2 c1 c2 =
      (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 2 0 *
          (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 1 3
        + (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 3 1 *
          (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 0 2
        + alpha * beta *
          ((momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 1 0 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 3 2
            - (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 1 2 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 3 0
            + (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 0 1 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 2 3
            - (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 0 3 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 2 1)
        - alpha ^ 2 * deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2
        - beta ^ 2 * deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2

      (∀ g : Mat4 K, g * P.X = X0 (delta P) → g = G.g) ∧

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSectionRootSwapTheorem
statement:
theorem NormalizedResidualSectionRootSwapTheorem
    (s : NormalizedResidualSection K) :
    rootSwap (rootSwap s) = s ∧
      (rootSwap s).M = s.M ∧
      DeltaStar (rootSwap s) = s.Delta ∧
      Sb (rootSwap s) = Sb s ∧
      Matrix.det (X0 s) = s.Delta ∧
      Matrix.det (A0 s) = DeltaStar s ∧
      A0 s * X0 s = s.M ∧
      s.Delta * DeltaStar s = Matrix.det s.M ∧
      Matrix.det (X0 (rootSwap s)) = DeltaStar s ∧
      Matrix.det (A0 (rootSwap s)) = s.Delta ∧
      s.Delta ^ 2 - Sb s * s.Delta + Matrix.det s.M = 0 ∧
      DeltaStar s ^ 2 - Sb s * DeltaStar s + Matrix.det s.M = 0

      (∀ z : K,
        sectionPolynomial s z = 0 ↔ z = s.Delta ∨ z = DeltaStar s) ∧

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.ResidualSL4BaseFibreTwoOrbitTheorem
statement:
theorem ResidualSL4BaseFibreTwoOrbitTheorem
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P)
    (hbranch : delta P ≠ deltaStar P) :
    let Pswap := rootSwappedRepresentative P hP
    delta Pswap = deltaStar P ∧
      deltaStar Pswap = delta P ∧
      baseMoment Pswap = baseMoment P ∧
      baseRootSum Pswap = baseRootSum P ∧
      ¬ Related P Pswap ∧
      ¬ Related Pswap P ∧
      (∀ Q : ResidualPair K,
        ¬ (Related P Q ∧ Related Pswap Q)) ∧
      ∀ Q : ResidualPair K, ResidualOpen Q →
        (sameResidualBase P Q ↔
          Related P Q ∨ Related Pswap Q)

statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ChartBridge.ChartResidualBaseSourceAutClassification
statement:
theorem ChartResidualBaseSourceAutClassification
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hP : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x))
    (hbranch : delta (residualPairOfChart x) ≠
      deltaStar (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    let P := residualPairOfChart x
    let Pswap := rootSwappedRepresentative P hP
    let xswap := chartWithResidualPair x Pswap
    residualPairOfChart xswap = Pswap ∧
      ∀ Q : ResidualPair K, ResidualOpen Q →
        (sameResidualBase P Q ↔
          SourceAutRelated x Q ∨ SourceAutRelated xswap Q) ∧
        ¬ (SourceAutRelated x Q ∧ SourceAutRelated xswap Q)

theorem sourceAutRelated_has_sourceAut
    {x : ExplicitFrameChart K} {Q : ResidualPair K}
    (h : SourceAutRelated x Q) :
    ∃ G : DetOneMatrix K,
      residualPairOfChart (actChart G x) = Q ∧
      (∀ d1 d2 d3 : K,
        (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (diagonal d1 d2 d3) =
          diagonal d1 d2 d3) ∧
      (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderA x) =
        encoderA (actChart G x) ∧
      (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderB x) =
        encoderB (actChart G x)

    (hM : ∀ i j, momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 i j ∈ F)
    (hUV : normalizedUV s1 s2 c1 c2 ∈ F) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualMomentSubfield.matrix_entries_mem
statement:
theorem matrix_entries_mem (F : Subfield K)
    (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K) (r1 z1 r2 z2 : K)
    (hr1 : r1 ∈ F) (hz1 : z1 ∈ F) (hr2 : r2 ∈ F) (hz2 : z2 ∈ F)
    (hk : r1 * z2 - r2 * z1 ≠ 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, M i i ∈ F)
    (hS : M 0 1 + M 1 0 ∈ F)
    (hC : M 2 3 + M 3 2 ∈ F)
    (hUC : r1 * z2 * M 0 1 + r2 * z1 * M 1 0 ∈ F)
    (hUS : r2 * z1 * M 2 3 + r1 * z2 * M 3 2 ∈ F)
    (ht : ∀ i j, (i = 0 ∨ i = 1) → (j = 2 ∨ j = 3) →
      (r1 * M i j + z1 * M j i ∈ F) ∧
      (r2 * M i j + z2 * M j i ∈ F)) :
    ∀ i j, M i j ∈ F

    (hdet : a * d - b * c ≠ 0)

    (hsecond : c * x + d * y ∈ F) : x ∈ F ∧ y ∈ F

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.uC_centered
statement:
theorem uC_centered (a b : JCoord K) :
    BC (sourceMuC a.v a.s) (sourceMuC b.v b.s) =
      BC (sourceSquare a).c (sourceSquare b).c -
      lC a * BC a.c (sourceSquare b).c -
      lC b * BC (sourceSquare a).c b.c + lC a * lC b * BC a.c b.c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.uS_centered
statement:
theorem uS_centered (a b : JCoord K) :
    BS (sourceMuS a.c a.v) (sourceMuS b.c b.v) =
      BS (sourceSquare a).s (sourceSquare b).s -
      lS a * BS a.s (sourceSquare b).s -
      lS b * BS (sourceSquare a).s b.s + lS a * lS b * BS a.s b.s

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.uV_centered
statement:
theorem uV_centered (a b : JCoord K) :
    normalizedUV a.s b.s a.c b.c =
      BV (sourceSquare a).v (sourceSquare b).v -
      lV a * BV a.v (sourceSquare b).v -
      lV b * BV (sourceSquare a).v b.v + lV a * lV b * BV a.v b.v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualSourceMeasurements.plane_muC_pairing
statement:
theorem plane_muC_pairing (r1 z1 r2 z2 : K) (s1 s2 : SCoord K) :
    BC (sourceMuC (planeVector r1 z1) s1)
      (sourceMuC (planeVector r2 z2) s2) =
      r1 * z2 * evalU s1.phi s2.p +
        r2 * z1 * evalU s2.phi s1.p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualSourceMeasurements.plane_muS_pairing
statement:
theorem plane_muS_pairing (r1 z1 r2 z2 : K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K) :
    BS (sourceMuS c1 (planeVector r1 z1))
      (sourceMuS c2 (planeVector r2 z2)) =
      r2 * z1 * evalU c1.psi c2.q +
        r1 * z2 * evalU c2.psi c1.q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualSourceMeasurements.plane_triality
statement:
theorem plane_triality (r z : K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    triality (planeVector r z) s c =
      r * evalU s.phi c.q + z * evalU c.psi s.p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualSourceMeasurements.within_gram_C
statement:
theorem within_gram_C (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualSourceMeasurements.within_gram_S
statement:
theorem within_gram_S (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K) :
    BS s1 s2 = momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 1 +
      momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.ledgerCells_subset_iff

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.ledgerField_eq_powerField

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.projectorWeight_mem

theorem projectorWeight_mem (F : Subfield K) (j p : Fin 3) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.projector_eq_weighted_powers
statement:
theorem projector_eq_weighted_powers (a : JCoord K) (j : Fin 3) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.residual_moments_mem_ledgerField
statement:
theorem residual_moments_mem_ledgerField (base : Subfield K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)

    (hr2 : x.r2 ∈ base) (hz2 : x.z2 ∈ base)
    (hk : orientation x ≠ 0)
    (hNa : sourceNorm (encoderA x) = 0) (hNb : sourceNorm (encoderB x) = 0) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformLedgerMeasurements.ledgerWeight_eq_powerWeight

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformLedgerMeasurements.recovered_measurements
statement:
theorem recovered_measurements (a b : JCoord K)
    (hNa : sourceNorm a = 0) (hNb : sourceNorm b = 0) :
    nVx (sourceLedger a b) = nV a.v ∧ nSx (sourceLedger a b) = nS a.s ∧
    nCx (sourceLedger a b) = nC a.c ∧ nVy (sourceLedger a b) = nV b.v ∧
    nSy (sourceLedger a b) = nS b.s ∧ nCy (sourceLedger a b) = nC b.c ∧
    gV (sourceLedger a b) 1 1 = BV a.v b.v ∧
    gS (sourceLedger a b) 1 1 = BS a.s b.s ∧
    gC (sourceLedger a b) 1 1 = BC a.c b.c ∧
    t111 (sourceLedger a b) = triality a.v a.s a.c ∧
    t211 (sourceLedger a b) = triality b.v a.s a.c ∧
    t121 (sourceLedger a b) = triality a.v b.s a.c ∧
    t112 (sourceLedger a b) = triality a.v a.s b.c ∧
    t122 (sourceLedger a b) = triality a.v b.s b.c ∧
    t212 (sourceLedger a b) = triality b.v a.s b.c ∧
    t221 (sourceLedger a b) = triality b.v b.s a.c ∧
    t222 (sourceLedger a b) = triality b.v b.s b.c ∧
    uV (sourceLedger a b) = normalizedUV a.s b.s a.c b.c ∧
    uS (sourceLedger a b) = BS (sourceMuS a.c a.v) (sourceMuS b.c b.v) ∧
    uC (sourceLedger a b) = BC (sourceMuC a.v a.s) (sourceMuC b.v b.s)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.evaluationAlong_productCoordinate

name: AlbertLean.Generic.BlockTrace.trace_prod_blocks
statement:
theorem trace_prod_blocks (L : M × N →ₗ[K] M × N) :
    LinearMap.trace K (M × N) L =
      LinearMap.trace K M
          ((LinearMap.fst K M N).comp (L.comp (LinearMap.inl K M N))) +
        LinearMap.trace K N
          ((LinearMap.snd K M N).comp (L.comp (LinearMap.inr K M N)))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.BlockTrace.trace_prod_three_blocks
statement:
theorem trace_prod_three_blocks
    {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module K P] [FiniteDimensional K P]
    (L : M × (N × P) →ₗ[K] M × (N × P)) :
    LinearMap.trace K (M × (N × P)) L =
      LinearMap.trace K M
          ((LinearMap.fst K M (N × P)).comp
            (L.comp (LinearMap.inl K M (N × P)))) +
        LinearMap.trace K N
          ((LinearMap.fst K N P).comp
            ((LinearMap.snd K M (N × P)).comp
              (L.comp ((LinearMap.inr K M (N × P)).comp
                (LinearMap.inl K N P))))) +
        LinearMap.trace K P
          ((LinearMap.snd K N P).comp
            ((LinearMap.snd K M (N × P)).comp
              (L.comp ((LinearMap.inr K M (N × P)).comp
                (LinearMap.inr K N P)))))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.adjugate_fin_three_trace
statement:
theorem adjugate_fin_three_trace (a : Mat3 K) :
    Matrix.adjugate a =
      a * a - Matrix.trace a • a +
        (((Matrix.trace a) ^ 2 - Matrix.trace (a * a)) / 2) •
          (1 : Mat3 K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.adjugate_of_projector_trace_one
statement:
theorem adjugate_of_projector_trace_one
    (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K)
    (hblock : a * a - a = -(hat u * hat v))
    (htrace : Matrix.trace a = 1) :
    Matrix.adjugate a = -outer v u

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.hat_mul
statement:
theorem hat_mul (u v : Vec3 K) :
    hat u * hat v = outer v u - dot u v • (1 : Mat3 K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.outer_eq_scaling
statement:
theorem outer_eq_scaling
    (u v u' v' : Vec3 K)
    (houter : outer v u = outer v' u')
    (hne : outer v u ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧ u' = t • u ∧ v' = t⁻¹ • v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.outer_eq_scaling_at_pivot
statement:
theorem outer_eq_scaling_at_pivot
    (u v u' v' : Vec3 K) (i j : Fin 3)
    (houter : outer v u = outer v' u')
    (hpivot : v i * u j ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧ u' = t • u ∧ v' = t⁻¹ • v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.same_a_scalar_fibre
statement:
theorem same_a_scalar_fibre
    (a : Mat3 K) (u v u' v' : Vec3 K)
    (hblock : a * a - a = -(hat u * hat v))
    (hblock' : a * a - a = -(hat u' * hat v'))
    (htrace : Matrix.trace a = 1)
    (hnonzero : Matrix.adjugate a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧ u' = t • u ∧ v' = t⁻¹ • v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.common_frame_scalar_fibre
statement:
theorem common_frame_scalar_fibre
    (a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (u v u' v' : Fin 3 → Vec3 K)
    (hblock : ∀ i, a i * a i - a i = -(hat (u i) * hat (v i)))
    (hblock' : ∀ i, a i * a i - a i = -(hat (u' i) * hat (v' i)))
    (htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (a i) = 1)
    (hadj : ∀ i, Matrix.adjugate (a i) ≠ 0)
    (hsumu : ThreeSumZero u) (hsumu' : ThreeSumZero u')
    (hsumv : ThreeSumZero v) (hsumv' : ThreeSumZero v')
    (hrankTwo :
      (∃ p q, u 0 p * u 1 q - u 0 q * u 1 p ≠ 0) ∨
      (∃ p q, v 0 p * v 1 q - v 0 q * v 1 p ≠ 0)) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, u' i = t • u i) ∧ (∀ i, v' i = t⁻¹ • v i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.three_scalars_eq_of_minor
statement:
theorem three_scalars_eq_of_minor
    (u : Fin 3 → Vec3 K) (t : Fin 3 → K) (p q : Fin 3)
    (hsum : ThreeSumZero u)
    (hscaled : ThreeScaledSumZero t u)
    (hminor : u 0 p * u 1 q - u 0 q * u 1 p ≠ 0) :
    t 0 = t 1 ∧ t 1 = t 2

    (B : V →ₗ[R] V →ₗ[R] R) (A C : V →ₗ[R] V)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairPolynomial.reconstructed_determinant_numerator
statement:
theorem reconstructed_determinant_numerator (p q r s d : K) :
    (s * d - nu p q r s d) * (d - 1) * nu p q r s d -
      (d * nu p q r s d + q * d * (d - 1) - nu p q r s d) *
        (d * nu p q r s d + r * d * (d - 1) - nu p q r s d) -
      d * (d - 1) * nu p q r s d =
        -(d * (d - 1)) * pairQuadratic p q r s d

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.cofactor_mul
statement:
theorem cofactor_mul (a b c d : K) :
    cofactorInverseNumerator a b c d * dephased a b c d =
      delta a b c d • (1 : Mat3 K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.dephased_inv_eq
statement:
theorem dephased_inv_eq (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) :
    (dephased a b c d)⁻¹ =
      (delta a b c d)⁻¹ • cofactorInverseNumerator a b c d

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.dephased_mul_cofactor
statement:
theorem dephased_mul_cofactor (a b c d : K) :

      delta a b c d • (1 : Mat3 K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.det_dephased

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.nu_mul_delta
statement:
theorem nu_mul_delta (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) :
    let p := overlap a b c d 0 0
    let q := overlap a b c d 0 1
    let r := overlap a b c d 1 0
    let s := overlap a b c d 1 1
    nu p q r s d * delta a b c d = d * (d - 1)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.overlap_table
statement:
theorem overlap_table (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) :
    (fun i j => overlap a b c d i j) =
      !![(a*d-b*c)/delta a b c d,
          (b-d)/delta a b c d, (c-a)/delta a b c d;
         (c-d)/delta a b c d,
          a*(d-1)/delta a b c d, b*(1-c)/delta a b c d;
         (b-a)/delta a b c d,
          c*(1-b)/delta a b c d, d*(a-1)/delta a b c d]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.pairQuadratic_root
statement:
theorem pairQuadratic_root (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) :
    pairQuadratic (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.reconstruct_entries
statement:
theorem reconstruct_entries (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0)
    (hnu : nu (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d ≠ 0) :
    let p := overlap a b c d 0 0
    let q := overlap a b c d 0 1
    let r := overlap a b c d 1 0
    let s := overlap a b c d 1 1
    let χ := d * (d - 1) / nu p q r s d
    a = s * d / nu p q r s d ∧ b = d + q * χ ∧ c = d + r * χ

      (overlap a' b' c' d' 1 0) (overlap a' b' c' d' 1 1) d' ≠ 0)
    (hover : ∀ i j, overlap a' b' c' d' i j = overlap a b c d i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.pairProbes_injective
statement:
theorem pairProbes_injective (F A B : Mat3 K)
    (hDelta : cycleDifference F ≠ 0)
    (hDiag : ∀ i, A i i = B i i)
    (hFirst : pairProbe F A 0 1 = pairProbe F B 0 1 ∧
      pairProbe F A 0 2 = pairProbe F B 0 2 ∧ pairProbe F A 1 2 = pairProbe F B 1 2)
    (hSecond : pairProbe (F * F) A 0 1 = pairProbe (F * F) B 0 1 ∧
      pairProbe (F * F) A 0 2 = pairProbe (F * F) B 0 2 ∧
      pairProbe (F * F) A 1 2 = pairProbe (F * F) B 1 2) :
    A = B

    (h₁ : pairProbe F A i k = pairProbe F B i k)
    (h₂ : pairProbe (F * F) A i k = pairProbe (F * F) B i k) :
    A k i = B k i ∧ A i k = B i k

    (hFirst : rowSymMeasurements F A = rowSymMeasurements F B)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeTrace.eq_of_trace_probes
statement:
theorem eq_of_trace_probes (F A B : Mat3 K)
    (hdet : Matrix.det (grading * F - F * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hDiag : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * A) = Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * B))
    (hFirst : ∀ i,
      Matrix.trace ((diagonalUnit i * F + F * diagonalUnit i) * A) =
        Matrix.trace ((diagonalUnit i * F + F * diagonalUnit i) * B))
    (hSecond : ∀ i,
      Matrix.trace ((diagonalUnit i * (F * F) + (F * F) * diagonalUnit i) * A) =
        Matrix.trace ((diagonalUnit i * (F * F) + (F * F) * diagonalUnit i) * B)) :
    A = B

    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder f0 f2 - encoder f0 f2 * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hLabel : ∀ i,
      labelledProbe f0 A i = labelledProbe f0 B i ∧

theorem lawfulFibre_two_full_classes (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x))
    (hlaw : LawfulFrameTriple (chartWitnessTriple x))
    (hsep : traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple x) ≠
      traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart x hx))) :
    InFibre x (residualPairOfChart x) ∧
    InFibre x (rootSwappedRepresentative (residualPairOfChart x) hx) ∧
    ¬ FullRelated (chartWitnessTriple x)
      (chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart x hx)) ∧
    (∀ Q, InFibre x Q → LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple x Q) ∧
      (FullRelated (chartWitnessTriple x) (fibreTriple x Q) ∨
       FullRelated (chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart x hx)) (fibreTriple x Q))) ∧
    (∀ Q R, InFibre x Q → InFibre x R →
      (FullRelated (fibreTriple x Q) (fibreTriple x R) ↔
       traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple x Q) = traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple x R)))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorScaling.traceCubeDetector_scaleFK
statement:
theorem traceCubeDetector_scaleFK (a b : ℚ) (E F K : Coord) :
    traceCubeDetector ⟨E, a • F, b • K⟩ =
      (a * b) ^ 3 * traceCubeDetector ⟨E, F, K⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorScaling.traceCubeDetector_scaleWitnessTriple

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorScaling.traceForm_smul_smul
statement:
theorem traceForm_smul_smul (a b : ℚ) (x y : Coord) :
    traceForm (a • x) (b • y) = a * b * traceForm x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.clearedA_eq_smul_laurentF
statement:
theorem clearedA_eq_smul_laurentF (F₀ VF : Coord) (t : ℚ)
    (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    clearedA F₀ VF t = t • laurentF F₀ VF t

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.clearedB_eq_smul_laurentK
statement:
theorem clearedB_eq_smul_laurentK (K₀ U V : Coord) (t : ℚ)
    (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    clearedB K₀ U V t = t • laurentK K₀ U V t

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.detectorDelta_eq
statement:
theorem detectorDelta_eq (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    detectorDelta E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t =
      m ^ 6 * t ^ 6 *
        (traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V t) -
          traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V (m / t)))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.detectorDelta_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem detectorDelta_ne_zero_iff (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    detectorDelta E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t ≠ 0 ↔
      traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V t) ≠
        traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V (m / t))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.detector_clearedAB
statement:
theorem detector_clearedAB (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (t : ℚ)
    (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    traceCubeDetector ⟨E, clearedA F₀ VF t, clearedB K₀ U V t⟩ =
      t ^ 6 * traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V t)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.detector_swappedCH
statement:
theorem detector_swappedCH (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    traceCubeDetector
        ⟨E, swappedC F₀ VF m t, swappedH K₀ U V m t⟩ =
      m ^ 6 * t ^ 3 *
        traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V (m / t))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.swappedC_eq_smul_laurentF
statement:
theorem swappedC_eq_smul_laurentF (F₀ VF : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    swappedC F₀ VF m t = m • laurentF F₀ VF (m / t)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.swappedH_eq_smul_laurentK
statement:
theorem swappedH_eq_smul_laurentK (K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    swappedH K₀ U V m t =
      (m * t) • laurentK K₀ U V (m / t)

theorem witness_fibre_classification (Q R : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : InFibre witnessChart1 Q) (hR : InFibre witnessChart1 R) :
    LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) ∧
    LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple witnessChart1 R) ∧
    (FullRelated (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) (fibreTriple witnessChart1 R) ↔
      traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) =
        traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple witnessChart1 R))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreMilestone.witness_fibre_has_two_classes
statement:
theorem witness_fibre_has_two_classes :
    ∃ Q R : ResidualPair ℚ,
      InFibre witnessChart1 Q ∧ InFibre witnessChart1 R ∧
      LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) ∧
      LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple witnessChart1 R) ∧
      ¬ FullRelated (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) (fibreTriple witnessChart1 R)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreMilestone.witness_fibre_invariant_affine
statement:
theorem witness_fibre_invariant_affine (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : InFibre witnessChart1 Q) (f : WitnessTriple → ℚ)
    (hf : ∀ {U V}, FullRelated U V → f U = f V) :
    let X₀ := chartWitnessTriple witnessChart1
    let X₁ := chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart witnessChart1 witnessChart1_open)
    let Y := fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q
    (detectorBit X₀ X₁ Y = 0 ∨ detectorBit X₀ X₁ Y = 1) ∧
      f Y = f X₀ + (f X₁ - f X₀) * detectorBit X₀ X₁ Y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreLedger.fibre_ledger_eq_of_separating_witness
statement:
theorem fibre_ledger_eq_of_separating_witness (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x))
    (W : ResidualPair ℚ) (hW : InFibre x W)

    (a : K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FieldAmalgamation.exists_common_field

    ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (left : L →+* E) (right : N →+* E),

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FieldPointOpenWitness.not_isNilpotent_of_injective_witness

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.C_apply

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.C_polar

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.C_reflection
statement:
theorem C_reflection (a v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.C_sandwich

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.C_square

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenReflections.nV_evenV

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.BS_evenS
statement:
theorem BS_evenS (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (s t : SCoord K)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    BS (evenS a b rho s) (evenS a b rho t) = BS s t

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.C_evenV_intertwine
statement:
theorem C_evenV_intertwine (a b v : VCoord K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0) :
    (C a * C b) * C v = C (evenV a b v) * (C a * C b)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.evenC_add
statement:
theorem evenC_add (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (c d : CCoord K) :
    evenC a b rho (c + d) = evenC a b rho c + evenC a b rho d

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.evenC_muC_intertwine
statement:
theorem evenC_muC_intertwine (a b v : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0) :
    evenC a b rho (sourceMuC v s) =
      sourceMuC (evenV a b v) (evenS a b rho s)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.evenS_add
statement:
theorem evenS_add (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (s t : SCoord K) :
    evenS a b rho (s + t) = evenS a b rho s + evenS a b rho t

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.evenS_muS_intertwine
statement:
theorem evenS_muS_intertwine (a b v : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0) :
    evenS a b rho (sourceMuS c v) =
      sourceMuS (evenC a b rho c) (evenV a b v)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.triality_even
statement:
theorem triality_even (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    triality (evenV a b v) (evenS a b rho s) (evenC a b rho c) =
      triality v s c

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.BV_reflectV
statement:
theorem BV_reflectV (a v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    BV a (reflectV a v) = -BV a v

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenCLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evenCLinear_apply (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (c : CCoord K) :
    evenCLinear a b rho c = evenC a b rho c

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenJEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evenJEquiv_apply (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    evenJEquiv a b rho ha hb hrho hrho0 x =
      { d1 := x.d1, d2 := x.d2, d3 := x.d3
        v := evenV a b x.v
        s := evenS a b rho x.s
        c := evenC a b rho x.c }

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenJEquiv_sourceNorm
statement:
theorem evenJEquiv_sourceNorm (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceNorm (evenJEquiv a b rho ha hb hrho hrho0 x) = sourceNorm x

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenJEquiv_sourceOne
statement:
theorem evenJEquiv_sourceOne (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    evenJEquiv a b rho ha hb hrho hrho0 sourceOne = sourceOne

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenSLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evenSLinear_apply (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (s : SCoord K) :
    evenSLinear a b rho s = evenS a b rho s

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenVLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evenVLinear_apply (a b v : VCoord K) :
    evenVLinear a b v = evenV a b v

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.reflectV_add
statement:
theorem reflectV_add (a v w : VCoord K) :
    reflectV a (v + w) = reflectV a v + reflectV a w

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.reflectV_involutive
statement:
theorem reflectV_involutive (a v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    reflectV a (reflectV a v) = v

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.reflectV_smul
statement:
theorem reflectV_smul (a v : VCoord K) (k : K) :
    reflectV a (k • v) = k • reflectV a v

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamily.center_eq
statement:
theorem center_eq (alpha : K) (B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : alpha ≠ 0) (hr : B.r ≠ 0)
    (hroot : rho ^ 2 = alpha * nV B) :
    center alpha B.r B.omega rho = B

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamily.center_root
statement:
theorem center_root (alpha r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K)
    (ha : alpha ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    rho ^ 2 = alpha * nV (center alpha r omega rho)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamily.norm_center
statement:
theorem norm_center (alpha r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    nV (center alpha r omega rho) = rho ^ 2 / alpha

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamily.norm_center_ne_zero
statement:
theorem norm_center_ne_zero (alpha r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K)
    (ha : alpha ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    nV (center alpha r omega rho) ≠ 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.JordanPolarization.polarizationMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem polarizationMap_apply
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (z : Fin 4 → V) :
    polarizationMap μ z = polarization μ (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.JordanPolarization.polarizationMap_eq_zero_of_residual_eq_zero
statement:
theorem polarizationMap_eq_zero_of_residual_eq_zero
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (h : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0) :
    polarizationMap μ = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.JordanPolarization.polarization_diagonal
statement:
theorem polarization_diagonal (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (x y : V) :
    polarization μ x x x y = (6 : K) • residual μ x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.JordanPolarization.polarization_eq_alternating
statement:
theorem polarization_eq_alternating
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (a b c y : V) :
    polarization μ a b c y =
      residual μ (a + b + c) y - residual μ (a + b) y -
      residual μ (a + c) y - residual μ (b + c) y +
      residual μ a y + residual μ b y + residual μ c y - residual μ 0 y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.JordanPolarization.polarization_eq_zero_of_residual_eq_zero
statement:
theorem polarization_eq_zero_of_residual_eq_zero
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (h : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0)
    (a b c y : V) : polarization μ a b c y = 0

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.RationalSourceJordan.sourceJordanIdentity_rat
statement:
theorem sourceJordanIdentity_rat (x y : JCoord ℚ) :
    sourceProduct (sourceProduct x y) (sourceProduct x x) =
      sourceProduct x (sourceProduct y (sourceProduct x x))

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericJordanExtension.f0JordanIdentity
statement:
theorem f0JordanIdentity (x y : F0Coord K) :
    f0ProductK (f0ProductK x y) (f0ProductK x x) =
      f0ProductK x (f0ProductK y (f0ProductK x x))

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericJordanExtension.f0PolarizationMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem f0PolarizationMap_eq_zero :
    polarizationMap (f0ProductLinearK (K := K)) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericJordanExtension.f0Polarization_basis_zero
statement:
theorem f0Polarization_basis_zero (i₀ i₁ i₂ i₃ : Fin 27) :
    polarization (f0ProductLinearK (K := K))
        (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i₀) (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i₁)
        (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i₂) (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i₃) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericJordanExtension.f0Polarization_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem f0Polarization_mapCoordQK (a b c y : Coord) :
    polarization (f0ProductLinearK (K := K))
        (mapCoordQK K a) (mapCoordQK K b)
        (mapCoordQK K c) (mapCoordQK K y) =
      mapCoordQK K
        (polarization (f0ProductLinearK (K := ℚ)) a b c y)

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericJordanExtension.rational_f0_polarization_zero
statement:
theorem rational_f0_polarization_zero (a b c y : Coord) :
    polarization (f0ProductLinearK (K := ℚ)) a b c y = 0

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericJordanExtension.rational_f0_residual_zero
statement:
theorem rational_f0_residual_zero (x y : Coord) :
    residual (f0ProductLinearK (K := ℚ)) x y = 0

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericJordanExtension.sourceJordanIdentity
statement:
theorem sourceJordanIdentity (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceProduct (sourceProduct x y) (sourceProduct x x) =
      sourceProduct x (sourceProduct y (sourceProduct x x))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeircePolynomial.reflection_one
statement:
theorem reflection_one
    (μ : A →ₗ[K] A →ₗ[K] A) (one p : A)
    (hone : μ p one = p) (hidem : μ p p = p) :
    reflection μ p one = one

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeircePolynomial.reflection_reflection
statement:
theorem reflection_reflection
    (μ : A →ₗ[K] A →ₗ[K] A) (p : A)
    (hcubic : ∀ x,
      (2 : K) • μ p (μ p (μ p x)) -
        (3 : K) • μ p (μ p x) + μ p x = 0)
    (x : A) : reflection μ p (reflection μ p x) = x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.peirce_operator_cubic
statement:
theorem peirce_operator_cubic
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0)
    (p : A) (hp : μ p p = p) (x : A) :
    (2 : K) • μ p (μ p (μ p x)) -
      (3 : K) • μ p (μ p x) + μ p x = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.polarization_zero
statement:
theorem polarization_zero
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0) (a b c y : A) :
    polarization μ a b c y = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflectionEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reflectionEquiv_apply
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0)
    (p : A) (hp : μ p p = p) (x : A) :
    reflectionEquiv μ hcomm hJordan p hp x = reflection μ p x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflectionEquiv_unit
statement:
theorem reflectionEquiv_unit
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0)
    (one p : A) (hone : μ p one = p) (hp : μ p p = p) :
    reflectionEquiv μ hcomm hJordan p hp one = one

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflection_add
statement:
theorem reflection_add (p x y : A) :
    reflection μ p (x + y) = reflection μ p x + reflection μ p y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflection_mul
statement:
theorem reflection_mul
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0)
    (p : A) (hp : μ p p = p) (x y : A) :
    reflection μ p (μ x y) = μ (reflection μ p x) (reflection μ p y)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflection_smul
statement:
theorem reflection_smul (p x : A) (c : K) :
    reflection μ p (c • x) = c • reflection μ p x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflection_square
statement:
theorem reflection_square
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0)
    (p : A) (hp : μ p p = p) (x : A) :
    reflection μ p (μ x x) = μ (reflection μ p x) (reflection μ p x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflection_square_certificate
statement:
theorem reflection_square_certificate
    (p : A) (hp : μ p p = p) (x : A) :
    reflection μ p (μ x x) - μ (reflection μ p x) (reflection μ p x) =
        (8 : K) • polarization μ p p (μ p x) x -
        (8 : K) • polarization μ p p x (μ p x) -
        (16 : K) • polarization μ p p (μ p x) (μ p x) -
        (4 : K) • polarization μ p x x p +
        (16 : K) • polarization μ p p x (μ p (μ p x)) -
        (8 : K) • μ x (polarization μ p p x p) +
        (16 : K) • μ (μ p x) (polarization μ p p x p)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply (p : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp x = sourcePeirceReflection p x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_one (p : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) :
    sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp sourceOne = sourceOne

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_product
statement:
theorem sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_product (p : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp (sourceProduct x y) =
      sourceProduct (sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp x)
        (sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp y)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceReflection_formula
statement:
theorem sourcePeirceReflection_formula (p x : JCoord K) :
    sourcePeirceReflection p x =
      x - (8 : K) • sourceProduct p x +
        (8 : K) • sourceProduct p (sourceProduct p x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRingReflectionFormula.map_ringProduct
statement:
theorem map_ringProduct {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.comp (algebraMap ℚ R) = algebraMap ℚ S)
    (x y : F0Ring R) :
    mapF0Ring f (ringProduct x y) =
      ringProduct (mapF0Ring f x) (mapF0Ring f y)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRingReflectionFormula.map_ringReflection
statement:
theorem map_ringReflection {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.comp (algebraMap ℚ R) = algebraMap ℚ S)
    (p x : F0Ring R) :
    mapF0Ring f (ringReflection p x) =
      ringReflection (mapF0Ring f p) (mapF0Ring f x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRingReflectionFormula.ringProduct_eq_f0ProductK
statement:
theorem ringProduct_eq_f0ProductK {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (x y : F0Ring K) : ringProduct x y = f0ProductK x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRingReflectionFormula.ringReflection_eq_source
statement:
theorem ringReflection_eq_source {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (p x : JCoord K) :
    ringReflection (structuredEquivK K p) (structuredEquivK K x) =
      structuredEquivK K (sourcePeirceReflection p x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.centerB_eq_center
statement:
theorem centerB_eq_center (alpha r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K) :
    centerB alpha⁻¹ r omega rho r⁻¹ = center alpha r omega rho

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.centerB_inverseNorm
statement:
theorem centerB_inverseNorm (alpha alphaInv r : R) (omega : W R)
    (rho rInv rhoInv : R) (ha : alpha * alphaInv = 1)
    (hr : r * rInv = 1) (hp : rho * rhoInv = 1) :
    ringNV (centerB alphaInv r omega rho rInv) * (alpha * rhoInv ^ 2) = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.familyF0_eq_sourceEvenAut
statement:
theorem familyF0_eq_sourceEvenAut
    (A : VCoord K) (hA : nV A ≠ 0)
    (r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    familyF0 A (nV A) (nV A)⁻¹ r omega rho r⁻¹ rho⁻¹
        (structuredEquivK K x) =
      structuredEquivK K ((familyAut A hA r omega rho hr hp).linear x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_familyF0
statement:
theorem map_familyF0 {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S] [Invertible (2 : S)]
    (f : R →+* S) (A : VCoord R) (alpha alphaInv r : R) (omega : W R)
    (rho rInv rhoInv : R) (x : F0Ring R) :
    mapF0 f (familyF0 A alpha alphaInv r omega rho rInv rhoInv x) =
      familyF0 (mapV f A) (f alpha) (f alphaInv) (f r) (mapW f omega)
        (f rho) (f rInv) (f rhoInv) (mapF0 f x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_twoFamilyF0
statement:
theorem map_twoFamilyF0 {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    [Invertible (2 : S)] (f : R →+* S)
    (A₁ A₂ : VCoord R)
    (alpha₁ alphaInv₁ r₁ : R) (omega₁ : W R) (rho₁ rInv₁ rhoInv₁ : R)
    (alpha₂ alphaInv₂ r₂ : R) (omega₂ : W R) (rho₂ rInv₂ rhoInv₂ : R)
    (x : F0Ring R) :
    mapF0 f
        (familyF0 A₂ alpha₂ alphaInv₂ r₂ omega₂ rho₂ rInv₂ rhoInv₂
          (familyF0 A₁ alpha₁ alphaInv₁ r₁ omega₁ rho₁ rInv₁ rhoInv₁ x)) =
      familyF0 (mapV f A₂) (f alpha₂) (f alphaInv₂) (f r₂) (mapW f omega₂)
        (f rho₂) (f rInv₂) (f rhoInv₂)
        (familyF0 (mapV f A₁) (f alpha₁) (f alphaInv₁) (f r₁) (mapW f omega₁)
          (f rho₁) (f rInv₁) (f rhoInv₁) (mapF0 f x))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.ringNV_centerB

@[simp] theorem mapF0_add (f : K →+* L) (x y : F0Coord K) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapF0_apply

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_add

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_comp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_diagonalUnit

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_injective
statement: theorem mapSource_injective (f : K →+* L) : Function.Injective (mapSource f)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapSource_one (f : K →+* L) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_product
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapSource_product (f : K →+* L) (x y : JCoord K) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapSource_smul (f : K →+* L) (a : K) (x : JCoord K) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_sub

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_trace
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapSource_trace (f : K →+* L) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (mapSource f x) = f (sourceTrace x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem mapSource_zero (f : K →+* L) : mapSource f 0 = 0

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.BV_neg_left
statement: theorem BV_neg_left (v w : VCoord K) : BV (-v) w = -BV v w

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.BV_neg_right
statement: theorem BV_neg_right (v w : VCoord K) : BV v (-w) = -BV v w

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.difference_pairing
statement:
theorem difference_pairing (x y : VCoord K) (hn : nV x = nV y) :
    BV (x - y) x = nV (x - y)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.exists_reflection_transport
statement:
theorem exists_reflection_transport (x y : VCoord K)
    (hn : nV x = nV y) (hx : nV x ≠ 0) :
    (∃ a, nV a ≠ 0 ∧ reflectV a x = y) ∨
      (∃ a b, nV a ≠ 0 ∧ nV b ≠ 0 ∧ reflectV b (reflectV a x) = y)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.nV_neg
statement: theorem nV_neg (v : VCoord K) : nV (-v) = nV v

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.nV_sub
statement:
theorem nV_sub (v w : VCoord K) :
    nV (v - w) = nV v + nV w - BV v w

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.nV_sum_eq_four
statement:
theorem nV_sum_eq_four (x y : VCoord K) (hn : nV x = nV y)
    (hd : nV (x - y) = 0) :
    nV (x + y) = 4 * nV x

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.reflect_difference
statement:
theorem reflect_difference (x y : VCoord K) (hn : nV x = nV y)
    (hd : nV (x - y) ≠ 0) :
    reflectV (x - y) x = y

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.reflect_neg_self
statement:
theorem reflect_neg_self (y : VCoord K) (hy : nV y ≠ 0) :
    reflectV y (-y) = y

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.reflect_sum
statement:
theorem reflect_sum (x y : VCoord K) (hn : nV x = nV y)
    (hd : nV (x - y) = 0) (hs : nV (x + y) ≠ 0) :
    reflectV (x + y) x = -y

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.sum_pairing
statement:
theorem sum_pairing (x y : VCoord K) (hn : nV x = nV y)
    (hd : nV (x - y) = 0) :
    BV (x + y) x = nV (x + y)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.BV_orthogonalRemainder
statement:
theorem BV_orthogonalRemainder (y₁ y₂ : VCoord K)
    (hy₁ : nV y₁ ≠ 0) :
    BV y₁ (orthogonalRemainder y₁ y₂) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.BV_reflectV
statement:
theorem BV_reflectV (a v w : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    BV (reflectV a v) (reflectV a w) = BV v w

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.nV_orthogonalRemainder_identity
statement:
theorem nV_orthogonalRemainder_identity (y₁ y₂ : VCoord K)
    (hy₁ : nV y₁ ≠ 0) :
    4 * nV y₁ * nV (orthogonalRemainder y₁ y₂) =
      4 * nV y₁ * nV y₂ - (BV y₁ y₂) ^ 2

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.nV_orthogonalRemainder_ne_zero
statement:
theorem nV_orthogonalRemainder_ne_zero (y₁ y₂ : VCoord K)
    (hy₁ : nV y₁ ≠ 0)
    (hGram : 4 * nV y₁ * nV y₂ - (BV y₁ y₂) ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    nV (orthogonalRemainder y₁ y₂) ≠ 0

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.reflectVLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reflectVLinear_apply (a v : VCoord K) :
    reflectVLinear a v = reflectV a v

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.reflectV_add
statement:
theorem reflectV_add (a v w : VCoord K) :
    reflectV a (v + w) = reflectV a v + reflectV a w

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal (a v : VCoord K)
    (horth : BV a v = 0) : reflectV a v = v

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.reflectV_smul
statement:
theorem reflectV_smul (a v : VCoord K) (k : K) :
    reflectV a (k • v) = k • reflectV a v

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_eq_fixing
statement:
theorem evenV_eq_fixing (e f x y : VCoord K)
    (he : nV e ≠ 0) (hxy : nV x = nV y) (hx : nV x ≠ 0)
    (hey : BV e y = 0) (hfe : BV f e = 0)
    (hfx : BV f x = 0) (hfy : BV f y = 0) :
    ∃ A B : VCoord K,
      nV A ≠ 0 ∧ nV B ≠ 0 ∧ BV f A = 0 ∧ BV f B = 0 ∧
      evenV A B x = y ∧ evenV A B f = f

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_eq_of_centers
statement:
theorem evenV_eq_of_centers (e x y : VCoord K)
    (he : nV e ≠ 0) (hxy : nV x = nV y) (hx : nV x ≠ 0)
    (hey : BV e y = 0) :
    ∃ A B : VCoord K,
      nV A ≠ 0 ∧ nV B ≠ 0 ∧ evenV A B x = y

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.BV_parityVector_plane
statement:
@[simp] theorem BV_parityVector_plane (r z : K) :
    BV (parityVector : VCoord K) (planeVector r z) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.BV_planeVector
statement:
@[simp] theorem BV_planeVector (r z r' z' : K) :
    BV (planeVector r z) (planeVector r' z') = r * z' + z * r'

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.nV_parityVector
statement: @[simp] theorem nV_parityVector : nV (parityVector : VCoord K) = 1

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.nV_planeVector
statement: @[simp] theorem nV_planeVector (r z : K) : nV (planeVector r z) = r * z

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.targetFirst_norm
statement: theorem targetFirst_norm (a : K) : nV (targetFirst a) = a

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.targetRemainder_eq
statement:
theorem targetRemainder_eq (a h s : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    targetRemainder a h s = planeVector (-s / (2 * a)) (s / 2)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.targetRemainder_norm
statement:
theorem targetRemainder_norm (a h s : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    nV (targetRemainder a h s) = -(s ^ 2) / (4 * a)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.targetSecond_norm
statement:
theorem targetSecond_norm (a h m s : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hs : s ^ 2 = h ^ 2 - 4 * a * m) :
    nV (targetSecond a h s) = m

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.target_pairing
statement:
theorem target_pairing (a h s : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    BV (targetFirst a) (targetSecond a h s) = h

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.BV_evenV
statement:
theorem BV_evenV (A B x y : VCoord K) (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0) :
    BV (evenV A B x) (evenV A B y) = BV x y

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_add
statement:
theorem evenV_add (A B x y : VCoord K) :
    evenV A B (x + y) = evenV A B x + evenV A B y

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_smul
statement:
theorem evenV_smul (A B x : VCoord K) (q : K) :
    evenV A B (q • x) = q • evenV A B x

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.exists_two_even_pairs_dephasing
statement:
theorem exists_two_even_pairs_dephasing
    (v1 v2 : VCoord K) (s : K)
    (ha : nV v1 ≠ 0)
    (hGram : 4 * nV v1 * nV v2 - (BV v1 v2) ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hs : s ^ 2 = (BV v1 v2) ^ 2 - 4 * nV v1 * nV v2) :
    ∃ A1 B1 A2 B2 : VCoord K,
      nV A1 ≠ 0 ∧ nV B1 ≠ 0 ∧ nV A2 ≠ 0 ∧ nV B2 ≠ 0 ∧
      evenV A2 B2 (evenV A1 B1 v1) = targetFirst (nV v1) ∧
      evenV A2 B2 (evenV A1 B1 v2) =
        targetSecond (nV v1) (BV v1 v2) s

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapSource_v
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapSource_v (f : K →+* L) (x : JCoord K) :
    (mapSource f x).v = mapV f x.v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV_BV
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapV_BV (f : K →+* L) (x y : VCoord K) :
    BV (mapV f x) (mapV f y) = f (BV x y)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapV_comp (g : L →+* M) (f : K →+* L) (x : VCoord K) :
    mapV g (mapV f x) = mapV (g.comp f) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV_evenV
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapV_evenV (f : K →+* L) (a b x : VCoord K) :
    mapV f (evenV a b x) = evenV (mapV f a) (mapV f b) (mapV f x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV_nV
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapV_nV (f : K →+* L) (x : VCoord K) :
    nV (mapV f x) = f (nV x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV_reflect
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapV_reflect (f : K →+* L) (a x : VCoord K) :
    mapV f (reflectV a x) = reflectV (mapV f a) (mapV f x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapV_smul (f : K →+* L) (a : K) (x : VCoord K) :
    mapV f (a • x) = f a • mapV f x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapV_sub (f : K →+* L) (x y : VCoord K) :
    mapV f (x-y) = mapV f x - mapV f y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV_targetFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapV_targetFirst (f : K →+* L) (a : K) :
    mapV f (targetFirst a) = targetFirst (f a)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV_targetSecond
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapV_targetSecond (f : K →+* L) (a h s : K) :
    mapV f (targetSecond a h s) = targetSecond (f a) (f h) (f s)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_secondCenter
statement:
theorem map_secondCenter {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    [Invertible (2 : S)] (f : R →+* S)
    (v1 v2 : VCoord R) (twoInv aInv a h sigma n1Inv : R) :
    mapV f (secondCenter v1 v2 twoInv aInv a h sigma n1Inv) =
      secondCenter (mapV f v1) (mapV f v2) (f twoInv) (f aInv)
        (f a) (f h) (f sigma) (f n1Inv)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.secondCenter_field
statement:
theorem secondCenter_field (v1 v2 : VCoord K) (a h sigma : K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hB1 : nV (firstCenter v1 a) ≠ 0)
    (hpair : BV (targetFirst a)
      (evenV parityVector (firstCenter v1 a) v2) = h) :
    secondCenter v1 v2 (2 : K)⁻¹ a⁻¹ a h sigma
        (nV (firstCenter v1 a))⁻¹ =
      orthogonalRemainder (targetFirst a)
          (evenV parityVector (firstCenter v1 a) v2) -
        targetRemainder a h sigma

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.stageOneVector_field
statement:
theorem stageOneVector_field (v1 v2 : VCoord K) (a : K)
    (hB1 : nV (firstCenter v1 a) ≠ 0) :
    stageOneVector v1 v2 a (nV (firstCenter v1 a))⁻¹ =
      evenV parityVector (firstCenter v1 a) v2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.targets_field
statement:
theorem targets_field (a h sigma : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    targetT a = targetFirst a ∧
    targetZ (2 : K)⁻¹ a⁻¹ a h sigma = targetSecond a h sigma ∧
    targetQ (2 : K)⁻¹ a⁻¹ a h sigma = targetRemainder a h sigma

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.charpoly_eval_neg_one_three
statement:
theorem charpoly_eval_neg_one_three (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) :
    M.charpoly.eval (-1) = -(1 + M).det

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.charpoly_eval_zero_three
statement:
theorem charpoly_eval_zero_three (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) :
    M.charpoly.eval 0 = -M.det

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.complementary_charpoly_endpoints
statement:
theorem complementary_charpoly_endpoints
    (X U V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hdetX : X.det = c) (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d)
    (hdetV : V.det = c ^ 2)
    (hdetNegOne : (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2) :
    let Z := -U - X
    Z.charpoly.eval 0 = -c ∧ Z.charpoly.eval (-1) = d

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.quadraticMatrix_eq_charmatrix_mul_charmatrix
statement:
theorem quadraticMatrix_eq_charmatrix_mul_charmatrix
    (X U V : Matrix n n R)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0) :
    quadraticMatrix U V =
      Matrix.charmatrix X * Matrix.charmatrix (-U - X)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.quadraticPolynomial_eq_charpoly_mul
statement:
theorem quadraticPolynomial_eq_charpoly_mul
    (X U V : Matrix n n R)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0) :
    quadraticPolynomial U V = X.charpoly * (-U - X).charpoly

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.quadraticPolynomial_eval_neg_one
statement:
theorem quadraticPolynomial_eval_neg_one (U V : Matrix n n R) :
    (quadraticPolynomial U V).eval (-1) = (1 - U + V).det

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.quadraticPolynomial_eval_zero
statement:
theorem quadraticPolynomial_eval_zero (U V : Matrix n n R) :
    (quadraticPolynomial U V).eval 0 = V.det

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.quadratic_factor_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem quadratic_factor_of_right_quadratic
    (r X U V : A) (hrX : r * X = X * r)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0) :
    (r - X) * (r + U + X) = r ^ 2 + r * U + V

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.cube_eq_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem cube_eq_of_right_quadratic (X U V : R)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0) :
    X ^ 3 = X * (U ^ 2 - V) + V * U

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.matrix_mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem matrix_mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
    (X U V : Matrix n n K) (t u v : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hcubic : X ^ 3 - t • X ^ 2 + u • X - v • 1 = 0) :
    X * (U ^ 2 - V + t • U + u • 1) =
      v • 1 - V * U - t • V

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.matrix_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem matrix_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
    (X U V : Matrix n n K) (t u v : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hcubic : X ^ 3 - t • X ^ 2 + u • X - v • 1 = 0)
    [Invertible (U ^ 2 - V + t • U + u • 1)] :
    X = (v • 1 - V * U - t • V) *
      ⅟(U ^ 2 - V + t • U + u • 1)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
    (X U V t u v : R)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hcubic : X ^ 3 - t * X ^ 2 + u * X - v = 0)
    (ht : t * X = X * t) (hu : u * X = X * u) :
    X * (U ^ 2 - V + t * U + u) = v - V * U - t * V

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
    (X U V t u v : R)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hcubic : X ^ 3 - t * X ^ 2 + u * X - v = 0)
    (ht : t * X = X * t) (hu : u * X = X * u)
    [Invertible (U ^ 2 - V + t * U + u)] :
    X = (v - V * U - t * V) * ⅟(U ^ 2 - V + t * U + u)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.sylvester_branch_eq_add_invOf
statement:
theorem sylvester_branch_eq_add_invOf
    (X U L : R) [Invertible L]
    (hsylvester : (-U - X) * L - L * X = 1) :
    ⅟L * (-U - X) * L = X + ⅟L

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.sylvester_branch_package
statement:
theorem sylvester_branch_package
    (X U V L : Matrix n n K) [Invertible L]
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hsylvester : (-U - X) * L - L * X = 1) :
    let Y := ⅟L * (-U - X) * L
    (Y ^ 2 + Y * U + V = 0) ∧
      (Y = X + ⅟L) ∧
      (Matrix.trace Y = -Matrix.trace U - Matrix.trace X)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.sylvester_branch_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem sylvester_branch_right_quadratic
    (X U V L : R) [Invertible L]
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hsylvester : (-U - X) * L - L * X = 1) :
    let Y := ⅟L * (-U - X) * L
    Y ^ 2 + Y * U + V = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.sylvester_conjugate_eq_add_invOf
statement:
theorem sylvester_conjugate_eq_add_invOf
    (X U L : R) [Invertible L]
    (hsylvester : (-U - X) * L - L * X = 1) :
    ⅟L * (-U - X) * L = X + ⅟L

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.sylvester_invOf_relation
statement:
theorem sylvester_invOf_relation
    (X U L : R) [Invertible L]
    (hsylvester : (-U - X) * L - L * X = 1) :
    X * ⅟L + ⅟L * X + ⅟L * U + ⅟L * ⅟L = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.trace_invOf_mul_mul
statement:
theorem trace_invOf_mul_mul
    (Z L : Matrix n n K) [Invertible L] :
    Matrix.trace (⅟L * Z * L) = Matrix.trace Z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.trace_sylvester_branch
statement:
theorem trace_sylvester_branch
    (X U L : Matrix n n K) [Invertible L] :
    Matrix.trace (⅟L * (-U - X) * L) =
      -Matrix.trace U - Matrix.trace X

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowQuadratic.cubicNormalForm_eval_neg_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cubicNormalForm_eval_neg_one (c d s : R) :
    (cubicNormalForm c d s).eval (-1) = d

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowQuadratic.cubicNormalForm_eval_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cubicNormalForm_eval_zero (c d s : R) :
    (cubicNormalForm c d s).eval 0 = -c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.charpoly_eq_cubicNormalForm_of_det_constraints
statement:
theorem charpoly_eq_cubicNormalForm_of_det_constraints
    (X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hdetX : X.det = c)
    (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d) :
    X.charpoly = cubicNormalForm c d (-Matrix.trace X)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_three_quadratic_roots
statement:
theorem eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_three_quadratic_roots
    (a b x y z : K)
    (hx : x ^ 2 + a * x + b = 0)
    (hy : y ^ 2 + a * y + b = 0)
    (hz : z ^ 2 + a * z + b = 0) :
    x = y ∨ x = z ∨ y = z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.matrix_cubic_identity_of_det_constraints
statement:
theorem matrix_cubic_identity_of_det_constraints
    (X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hdetX : X.det = c)
    (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d) :
    X ^ 3 - Matrix.trace X • X ^ 2 +
        (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • X - c • 1 = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_constraints
statement:
theorem matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_constraints
    (X U V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hdetX : X.det = c)
    (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d)
    [Invertible (U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace X • U +
      (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • 1)] :
    X = (c • 1 - V * U - Matrix.trace X • V) *
      ⅟(U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace X • U +
        (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • 1)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_det_ne_zero
    (X U V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hdetX : X.det = c)
    (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d)
    (hE : (U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace X • U +
      (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • 1).det ≠ 0) :
    X = (c • 1 - V * U - Matrix.trace X • V) *
      (U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace X • U +
        (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • 1)⁻¹

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowUniqueness.eq_of_goodSolution_of_trace_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_goodSolution_of_trace_eq
    (U V : Mat3 K) (c d : K) {X Y : Mat3 K}
    (hX : GoodSolution U V c d X)
    (hY : GoodSolution U V c d Y)
    (htrace : Matrix.trace X = Matrix.trace Y) : X = Y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowUniqueness.eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_quadratic_invariant
statement:
theorem eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_quadratic_invariant
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {A : Type v}
    (P : A -> Prop) (f : A -> K) (a b : K)
    (hroot : ∀ x, P x -> f x ^ 2 + b * f x + a = 0)
    (hinjective : ∀ {x y}, P x -> P y -> f x = f y -> x = y)
    {x y z : A} (hx : P x) (hy : P y) (hz : P z) :
    x = y ∨ x = z ∨ y = z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowUniqueness.three_goodSolutions_pairwise_eq
statement:
theorem three_goodSolutions_pairwise_eq
    (U V : Mat3 K) (c d : K)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hdetV : V.det = c ^ 2)
    (hdetNegOne : (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2)
    (X Y Z : Mat3 K)
    (hX : GoodSolution U V c d X)
    (hY : GoodSolution U V c d Y)
    (hZ : GoodSolution U V c d Z) :
    X = Y ∨ X = Z ∨ Y = Z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameDeterminants.adjugate_normalized_endpoint_determinants
statement:
theorem adjugate_normalized_endpoint_determinants
    (a0 a1 a2 : Mat3 K) (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) :
    let A0 := Matrix.adjugate a0
    let A1 := Matrix.adjugate a1
    let A2 := Matrix.adjugate a2
    let c := a1.det / a0.det
    let d := a2.det / a0.det
    let U := (A0 + A1 - A2) * A0⁻¹
    let V := A1 * A0⁻¹
    V.det = c ^ 2 ∧ (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameDeterminants.normalized_endpoint_determinants
statement:
theorem normalized_endpoint_determinants
    (A0 A1 A2 A0i U V : Mat3 K) (c d : K)
    (hA0i : A0 * A0i = 1)
    (hU : U = (A0 + A1 - A2) * A0i)
    (hV : V = A1 * A0i)
    (hdetA1 : A1.det = c ^ 2 * A0.det)
    (hdetA2 : A2.det = d ^ 2 * A0.det) :
    V.det = c ^ 2 ∧ (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2

    (hV : V = A1 * A0⁻¹)
    (hdetA1 : A1.det = c ^ 2 * A0.det)
    (hdetA2 : A2.det = d ^ 2 * A0.det) :
    V.det = c ^ 2 ∧ (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjugateSystem.adjugate_equations_of_componentSolution
statement:
theorem adjugate_equations_of_componentSolution
    (a0 a1 a2 X : Mat3 K)
    (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) (ha1 : a1.det ≠ 0) (ha2 : a2.det ≠ 0)
    (hX : ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 X) :
    let a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K := ![a0, a1, a2]
    let b : Fin 3 → Mat3 K := ![a0, X * a0, -(1 + X) * a0]
    let c : Fin 3 → Mat3 K := fun i => (b i)⁻¹ * (a i).adjugate
    (∀ i, (a i).adjugate = b i * c i ∧
      (c i).adjugate = a i * b i ∧ (b i).adjugate = c i * a i) ∧
      b 0 + b 1 + b 2 = 0 ∧ c 0 + c 1 + c 2 = 0

      (c i).adjugate = a i * b i ∧ (b i).adjugate = c i * a i)
    (hbsum : b 0 + b 1 + b 2 = 0) (hcsum : c 0 + c 1 + c 2 = 0)
    (hden : (reconstructionDenominator (componentU (a 0) (a 1) (a 2))
      (componentV (a 0) (a 1)) ((a 1).det / (a 0).det) ((a 2).det / (a 0).det)
      (Matrix.trace (normalizedX (a 0) (b 0) (b 1)))).det ≠ 0) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ThreeIdempotents.adjoint_eq_zero_iff_mul_self_eq_self
statement:
theorem adjoint_eq_zero_iff_mul_self_eq_self
    (trace scalar : A → K) (sharp : A → A) (x : A)
    (adjoint_identity : sharp x = x * x - trace x • x + scalar x • (1 : A))
    (trace_sharp : trace (sharp x) = scalar x) (trace_zero : trace 0 = 0)
    (trace_smul_one : ∀ k : K, trace (k • (1 : A)) = k + k + k)
    (htwo : ∀ k : K, k + k = 0 → k = 0) (htrace : trace x = 1) :
    sharp x = 0 ↔ x * x = x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ThreeIdempotents.mul_self_eq_self_of_adjoint_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mul_self_eq_self_of_adjoint_eq_zero

    (adjoint_identity :
      sharp x = x * x - trace x • x + scalar x • (1 : A))
    (trace_sharp : trace (sharp x) = scalar x)
    (trace_zero : trace 0 = 0)
    (htrace : trace x = 1)
    (hsharp : sharp x = 0) : x * x = x

    (htwo : ∀ x : A, x + x = 0 → x = 0)
    (h0 : e0 * e0 = e0) (h1 : e1 * e1 = e1) (h2 : e2 * e2 = e2)
    (hsum : e0 + e1 + e2 = 1) :
    e0 * e1 = 0 ∧ e0 * e2 = 0 ∧ e1 * e2 = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FrameEncoder.encoder_identities
statement:
theorem encoder_identities
    (e0 e1 e2 : A)
    (hcomm : ∀ a b : A, a * b = b * a)
    (htwo : ∀ a : A, a + a = 0 → a = 0)
    (h0 : e0 * e0 = e0) (h1 : e1 * e1 = e1) (h2 : e2 * e2 = e2)
    (hsum : e0 + e1 + e2 = 1) :
    let x := e2 - e0
    x * x = e0 + e2 ∧
    x * (x * x) = x ∧
    x * x - x = e0 + e0 ∧
    1 - x * x = e1 ∧
    x * x + x = e2 + e2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FrameEncoder.literal_projectors
statement:
theorem literal_projectors
    (e0 e1 e2 x : A) (htwoK : (2 : K) ≠ 0)
    (hminus : x * x - x = e0 + e0)
    (hmiddle : 1 - x * x = e1)
    (hplus : x * x + x = e2 + e2) :
    (2 : K)⁻¹ • (x * x - x) = e0 ∧
    1 - x * x = e1 ∧
    (2 : K)⁻¹ • (x * x + x) = e2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FrameEncoder.trace_encoder

    (htr0 : trace e0 = 1)
    (htr2 : trace e2 = 1) :
    trace x = 0 ∧ trace (x * x) = 2

theorem agreement_of_generic_cleared_transport
    {R S F L : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Field F] [Field L]
    (i : R →+* F) (j : R →+* S) (e : S →+* L)
    (φ ψ : F →+* L) (α : S ≃+* S)
    (hleft : e.comp j = φ.comp i)
    (hright : (e.comp α.toRingHom).comp j = ψ.comp i)
    (a b : R) (hb : i b ≠ 0)
    (hclear : α (j a) * j b = j a * α (j b)) :
    φ (i a / i b) = ψ (i a / i b)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.mixedC_pair
statement:
theorem mixedC_pair (s1 s2 : SCoord ℚ) (c1 c2 : CCoord ℚ)
    (u u' a a' r1 z1 r2 z2 : ℚ) :
    BC (mixedC s1 c1 u a r1 z1) (mixedC s2 c2 u' a' r2 z2) =
      u * u' * (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 2 3 + momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 3 2) +
      u * a' * z2 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 2 1 +
      a * r1 * u' * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 3 +
      a * a' * r1 * z2 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 1 +
      u' * a * z1 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 3 0 +
      a' * r2 * u * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 2 +
      a * a' * r2 * z1 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.mixedS_pair
statement:
theorem mixedS_pair (s1 s2 : SCoord ℚ) (c1 c2 : CCoord ℚ)
    (u u' a a' r1 z1 r2 z2 : ℚ) :
    BS (mixedS s1 c1 u a r1 z1) (mixedS s2 c2 u' a' r2 z2) =
      u * u' * (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 1 + momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 0) +
      u * a' * r2 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 3 +
      a * z1 * u' * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 2 1 +
      a * a' * z1 * r2 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 2 3 +
      u' * a * r1 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 2 +
      a' * z2 * u * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 3 0 +
      a * a' * z2 * r1 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 3 2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.mixedV_pair
statement:
theorem mixedV_pair (v1 v2 : VCoord ℚ)
    (h1 : v1.omega = 0) (h2 : v2.omega = 0)
    (s1 s2 : SCoord ℚ) (c1 c2 : CCoord ℚ) (u u' a a' : ℚ) :
    BV (mixedV v1 s1 c1 u a) (mixedV v2 s2 c2 u' a') =
      u * u' * (v1.r * v2.z + v1.z * v2.r) +
      u * a' * (v1.r * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 3 +
        v1.z * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 3 1) +
      a * u' * (v2.r * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 2 +
        v2.z * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 2 0) +
      a * a' * (exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) -
        deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2 - deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2)

    x.z1 = nV (vectorA x) ∧

      x.z2 = (g + orientation x) / 2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.ledger_C0_reinsert
statement:
theorem ledger_C0_reinsert (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    (ledger (chartWitnessTriple (chartWithResidualPair x Q))).C0 i j l =
      (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).C0 i j l +
        centeredJointCoeff i * projectorSquareCoeff j *
          projectorSquareCoeff l *
            (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.ledger_Q_reinsert
statement:
theorem ledger_Q_reinsert (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (j l : Fin 3) :
    (ledger (chartWitnessTriple (chartWithResidualPair x Q))).Q j l =
      (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).Q j l +
        projectorSquareCoeff j * projectorSquareCoeff l *
          (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.ledger_R_reinsert

theorem ledger_R_reinsert (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)

theorem ledger_eq_reciprocal_of_rootSumLedgerLaw

          (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht)) =

theorem ledger_reinsert_eq_shiftLedger (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameterRootSum_eq_Q11

theorem parameterRootSum_eq_Q11 (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    parameterRootSum t =
      1 + witnessScale +
        (ledger (parameterTriple 1 one_ne_zero)).Q 1 1 -
          (ledger (parameterTriple t ht)).Q 1 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameterRootSum_eq_of_Q11AffineLaw
statement:
theorem parameterRootSum_eq_of_Q11AffineLaw
    (hLaw : Q11AffineLaw) (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameter_Q11_affine

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyInverse.sourceEvenAut_reflected_inverse
statement:
theorem sourceEvenAut_reflected_inverse
    (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    let hb' : nV (reflectV a b) ≠ 0 := by simpa [nV_reflectV a b ha] using hb
    let hrho' : (-rho) ^ 2 = nV a * nV (reflectV a b) := by
      simpa [nV_reflectV a b ha] using hrho
    (sourceEvenAut a (reflectV a b) (-rho) ha hb' hrho'
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr hrho0)).linear =
      (sourceEvenAut a b rho ha hb hrho hrho0).linear.symm

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.clifford_even_conjugate
statement:
theorem clifford_even_conjugate (e c A B : VCoord K)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.evenC_conjugate
statement:
theorem evenC_conjugate (e c A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (he : nV e = 1) (hc : nV c = 1) (d : CCoord K) :
    evenC e (reflectV e c) (-1)
      (evenC (evenV e c A) (evenV e c B) rho
        (evenC e c 1 d)) = evenC A B rho d

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.evenS_conjugate

theorem evenS_conjugate (e c A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)

        (evenS e c 1 s)) = evenS A B rho s

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.evenV_conjugate

theorem evenV_conjugate (e c A B v : VCoord K)
    (he : nV e ≠ 0) (hc : nV c ≠ 0) :

      (evenV (evenV e c A) (evenV e c B) (evenV e c v)) =

theorem reflectV_covariant (a b v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.reflectV_injective

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.sourceEvenAut_linear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceEvenAut_linear_apply
    (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hr : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hr0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    (sourceEvenAut a b rho ha hb hr hr0).linear x =
      { d1 := x.d1, d2 := x.d2, d3 := x.d3
        v := evenV a b x.v
        s := evenS a b rho x.s
        c := evenC a b rho x.c }

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenMiddleFactor.evenC_middle
statement:
theorem evenC_middle (e A B : VCoord K) (alpha beta rho : K)
    (he : nV e = 1) (hab : alpha * beta = rho)
    (ha0 : alpha ≠ 0) (hb0 : beta ≠ 0) (c : CCoord K) :
    evenC e (reflectV e A) (-alpha)
      (evenC e B beta c) = evenC A B rho c

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenMiddleFactor.evenS_middle
statement:
theorem evenS_middle (e A B : VCoord K) (alpha beta rho : K)

    (ha0 : alpha ≠ 0) (hb0 : beta ≠ 0) (s : SCoord K) :
    evenS e (reflectV e A) (-alpha)
      (evenS e B beta s) = evenS A B rho s

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenMiddleFactor.evenV_middle
statement:
theorem evenV_middle (e A B v : VCoord K) (he0 : nV e ≠ 0) :
    evenV e (reflectV e A) (evenV e B v) = evenV A B v

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenMiddleFactor.sourceEvenAut_middle_apply
statement:
theorem sourceEvenAut_middle_apply
    (e A B : VCoord K) (alpha beta rho : K)
    (he : nV e = 1)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (ha : alpha ^ 2 = nV A) (hb : beta ^ 2 = nV B)
    (hab : alpha * beta = rho)
    (ha0 : alpha ≠ 0) (hb0 : beta ≠ 0) (hr0 : rho ≠ 0)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    let he0 : nV e ≠ 0 := by simpa [he]
    let hRA : nV (reflectV e A) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [nV_reflectV e A he0] using hA
    let hneg : (-alpha) ^ 2 = nV e * nV (reflectV e A) := by
      rw [he, one_mul, nV_reflectV e A he0]
      simpa using ha
    let heB : beta ^ 2 = nV e * nV B := by simpa [he] using hb
    let hr : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B := by rw [← hab, mul_pow, ha, hb]
    (sourceEvenAut e (reflectV e A) (-alpha) he0 hRA hneg
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr ha0)).linear
        ((sourceEvenAut e B beta he0 hB heB hb0).linear x) =
      (sourceEvenAut A B rho hA hB hr hr0).linear x

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenSourceAut_apply_diagonal
statement:
@[simp] theorem evenSourceAut_apply_diagonal (A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    (((evenSourceAut A B rho hA hB hrho hrho0).linear x).d1,
      ((evenSourceAut A B rho hA hB hrho hrho0).linear x).d2,
      ((evenSourceAut A B rho hA hB hrho hrho0).linear x).d3) =
      (x.d1, x.d2, x.d3)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenSourceAut_apply_v
statement:
@[simp] theorem evenSourceAut_apply_v (A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    ((evenSourceAut A B rho hA hB hrho hrho0).linear x).v = evenV A B x.v

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyFixedBranch.familyAut_linear_eq_fixed_center
statement:
theorem familyAut_linear_eq_fixed_center
    (A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0) (hBr : B.r ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    (familyAut A hA B.r B.omega rho hBr hrho0).linear =
      (sourceEvenAut A B rho hA hB hrho hrho0).linear

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyFixedBranch.two_familyAut_apply_eq_fixed_centers
statement:
theorem two_familyAut_apply_eq_fixed_centers
    (A1 B1 A2 B2 : VCoord K) (rho1 rho2 : K)
    (hA1 : nV A1 ≠ 0) (hB1 : nV B1 ≠ 0) (hB1r : B1.r ≠ 0)
    (hroot1 : rho1 ^ 2 = nV A1 * nV B1) (hrho1 : rho1 ≠ 0)
    (hA2 : nV A2 ≠ 0) (hB2 : nV B2 ≠ 0) (hB2r : B2.r ≠ 0)
    (hroot2 : rho2 ^ 2 = nV A2 * nV B2) (hrho2 : rho2 ≠ 0)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    (familyAut A2 hA2 B2.r B2.omega rho2 hB2r hrho2).linear
        ((familyAut A1 hA1 B1.r B1.omega rho1 hB1r hrho1).linear x) =
      (sourceEvenAut A2 B2 rho2 hA2 hB2 hroot2 hrho2).linear
        ((sourceEvenAut A1 B1 rho1 hA1 hB1 hroot1 hrho1).linear x)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenFourFactor.fixedParityAut_linear_eq
statement:
theorem fixedParityAut_linear_eq (D : VCoord K) (s : K)
    (hr : D.r ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hsq : s ^ 2 = nV D) :
    (fixedParityAut D s hr hs).linear =
      (sourceEvenAut parityVector D s (by simp)
        (by rw [← hsq]; exact pow_ne_zero 2 hs)
        (by simpa using hsq) hs).linear

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PrimeKernelByFieldPoints.radical_eq_ker_of_prime_field_squares
statement:
theorem radical_eq_ker_of_prime_field_squares
    (J : Ideal R) (psi : R →+* S)
    (hJ : J ≤ RingHom.ker psi)
    (hsquare : ∀ (p : Ideal R) (hp : p.IsPrime), J ≤ p →
      ∃ (L : Type w) (_ : Field L) (j : R ⧸ p →+* L),
        Function.Injective j ∧
        ∃ e : S →+* L,
          e.comp psi = j.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk p)) :
    J.radical = RingHom.ker psi

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.BlockEigenbasis.characteristic_roots

theorem characteristic_roots (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K)
    (hroot : sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    (lambdaPlus X sigma) ^ 2 - trace2 X * lambdaPlus X sigma + determinant X = 0 ∧
    (lambdaMinus X sigma) ^ 2 - trace2 X * lambdaMinus X sigma + determinant X = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.BlockEigenbasis.determinant_affine

theorem determinant_affine (s t : K) (X : Mat2 K) :
