name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.BlockEigenbasis.eigenbasis_intertwines
statement:
theorem eigenbasis_intertwines (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K)
    (hb : X 0 1 ≠ 0) (hs : sigma ≠ 0)
    (hroot : sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    X * eigenbasis X sigma = eigenbasis X sigma * eigenvalues X sigma

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.BlockEigenbasis.trace_eq_of_two_determinants
statement:
theorem trace_eq_of_two_determinants (s t : K) (hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (X Y : Mat2 K) (hdet : determinant X = determinant Y)
    (haffine : determinant (affine s t X) = determinant (affine s t Y)) :
    trace2 X = trace2 Y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.blocks_eq_of_pivot_eq
statement:
theorem blocks_eq_of_pivot_eq (B C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K)
    (p q : Fin 3 → K) (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdB : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrB : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hcB : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hdC : ∀ i, C i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrC : ∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0)
    (hcC : ∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0)
    (hX : B 0 1 = C 0 1) : B = C

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.scaled_block_equations
statement:
theorem scaled_block_equations (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K)
    (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hd : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0) :
    B 0 2 = -q 0 • (1 : Mat2 K) - B 0 1 ∧
    p 2 • B 2 1 = -p 0 • B 0 1 - (p 1 * q 1) • (1 : Mat2 K) ∧
    p 2 • B 2 0 = p 0 • B 0 1 + (p 1 * q 1 - p 2 * q 2) • (1 : Mat2 K) ∧
    p 1 • B 1 0 = -p 0 • B 0 1 +
      (-p 0 * q 0 - p 1 * q 1 + p 2 * q 2) • (1 : Mat2 K) ∧
    p 1 • B 1 2 = p 0 • B 0 1 +
      (p 0 * q 0 - p 2 * q 2) • (1 : Mat2 K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.mul_adj
statement: theorem mul_adj (X : Mat2 K) : X * adj X = determinant X • (1 : Mat2 K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.pivot_determinant_relation
statement:
theorem pivot_determinant_relation (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K) (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hd : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hs1 : p 1 • B 1 0 = p 0 • adj (B 0 1))
    (hs2 : p 2 • B 2 0 = p 0 • adj (B 0 2))
    (hi : B 0 0 * B 0 0 + B 0 1 * B 1 0 + B 0 2 * B 2 0 = B 0 0) :
    p 0 * (p 1 + p 2) * determinant (B 0 1) =
      p 1 * p 2 * (q 0 - q 0 ^ 2) -
        p 0 * p 1 * (q 0 ^ 2 + q 0 * trace2 (B 0 1))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.pivot_trace_relation
statement:
theorem pivot_trace_relation (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K) (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hd : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hs : p 1 • B 1 0 = p 0 • adj (B 0 1)) :
    p 0 * trace2 (B 0 1) = -p 0 * q 0 - p 1 * q 1 + p 2 * q 2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.weighted_product
statement:
theorem weighted_product (p q : K) (X Y : Mat2 K)
    (h : p • Y = q • adj X) :
    p • (X * Y) = (q * determinant X) • (1 : Mat2 K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CyclicBlockNormalizer.cyclic_intertwines
statement:
theorem cyclic_intertwines (X : Mat2 K) :
    X * cyclicBasis X = cyclicBasis X * companion X

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CyclicBlockNormalizer.cyclic_inv_mul
statement:
theorem cyclic_inv_mul (X : Mat2 K) (h : X 0 1 ≠ 0) :
    cyclicBasisInv X * cyclicBasis X = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CyclicBlockNormalizer.cyclic_mul_inv
statement:
theorem cyclic_mul_inv (X : Mat2 K) (h : X 0 1 ≠ 0) :
    cyclicBasis X * cyclicBasisInv X = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CyclicBlockNormalizer.rational_intertwiner
statement:
theorem rational_intertwiner (X Y : Mat2 K)
    (hx : X 0 1 ≠ 0) (hy : Y 0 1 ≠ 0)
    (ht : trace2 X = trace2 Y) (hd : determinant X = determinant Y) :
    let T := cyclicBasis X * cyclicBasisInv Y
    let S := cyclicBasis Y * cyclicBasisInv X
    T * S = 1 ∧ S * T = 1 ∧ X * T = T * Y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockConjugacy.all_blocks_conjugate
statement:
theorem all_blocks_conjugate (B C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K)
    (p q : Fin 3 → K) (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdB : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrB : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hcB : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hdC : ∀ i, C i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrC : ∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0)
    (hcC : ∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0)
    (T S : Mat2 K) (hTS : T * S = 1)
    (hX : B 0 1 * T = T * C 0 1) :
    ∀ i j, B i j = T * C i j * S

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockConjugacy.exists_common_conjugator
statement:
theorem exists_common_conjugator (B C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K)
    (p q : Fin 3 → K) (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdB : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrB : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hcB : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hdC : ∀ i, C i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrC : ∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0)
    (hcC : ∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0)
    (hB : B 0 1 0 1 ≠ 0) (hC : C 0 1 0 1 ≠ 0)
    (ht : trace2 (B 0 1) = trace2 (C 0 1))
    (hd : determinant (B 0 1) = determinant (C 0 1)) :
    ∃ T S : Mat2 K, T * S = 1 ∧ S * T = 1 ∧
      ∀ i j, B i j = T * C i j * S

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicBasisAt_intertwines
statement:
theorem cyclicBasisAt_intertwines (X : Mat2 K) (v : Vec2 K) :
    X * cyclicBasisAt X v = cyclicBasisAt X v * companion X

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicBasisAt_inv_mul
statement:
theorem cyclicBasisAt_inv_mul (X : Mat2 K) (v : Vec2 K)
    (hv : cyclicDet X v ≠ 0) :
    cyclicBasisAtInv X v * cyclicBasisAt X v = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicBasisAt_mul_inv
statement:
theorem cyclicBasisAt_mul_inv (X : Mat2 K) (v : Vec2 K)
    (hv : cyclicDet X v ≠ 0) :
    cyclicBasisAt X v * cyclicBasisAtInv X v = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicDet_e0
statement: @[simp] theorem cyclicDet_e0 (X : Mat2 K) : cyclicDet X e0 = X 1 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicDet_e0_add_e1
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicDet_e0_add_e1 (X : Mat2 K) :
    cyclicDet X (e0 + e1) = X 1 0 + X 1 1 - X 0 0 - X 0 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicDet_e1
statement: @[simp] theorem cyclicDet_e1 (X : Mat2 K) : cyclicDet X e1 = -X 0 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.exists_all_blocks_conjugate
statement:
theorem exists_all_blocks_conjugate (B C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K)
    (p q : Fin 3 → K) (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdB : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrB : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hcB : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hdC : ∀ i, C i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrC : ∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0)
    (hcC : ∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0)
    (hB : ¬ ∃ a : K, B 0 1 = a • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hC : ¬ ∃ a : K, C 0 1 = a • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (ht : trace2 (B 0 1) = trace2 (C 0 1))
    (hd : determinant (B 0 1) = determinant (C 0 1)) :
    ∃ T S : Mat2 K, T * S = 1 ∧ S * T = 1 ∧
      ∀ i j, B i j = T * C i j * S

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.exists_three_cyclic
statement:
theorem exists_three_cyclic (X : Mat2 K)
    (hX : ¬ ∃ a : K, X = a • (1 : Mat2 K)) :
    ∃ v : Vec2 K, (v = e0 ∨ v = e1 ∨ v = e0 + e1) ∧ cyclicDet X v ≠ 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.nonscalar_of_discriminant_ne_zero
statement:
theorem nonscalar_of_discriminant_ne_zero (X : Mat2 K)
    (hdisc : trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X ≠ 0) :
    ¬ ∃ a : K, X = a • (1 : Mat2 K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.rational_intertwiner_of_nonscalar
statement:
theorem rational_intertwiner_of_nonscalar (X Y : Mat2 K)
    (hX : ¬ ∃ a : K, X = a • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hY : ¬ ∃ a : K, Y = a • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (ht : trace2 X = trace2 Y) (hd : determinant X = determinant Y) :
    ∃ vx vy : Vec2 K,
      (vx = e0 ∨ vx = e1 ∨ vx = e0 + e1) ∧
      (vy = e0 ∨ vy = e1 ∨ vy = e0 + e1) ∧
      let T := cyclicBasisAt X vx * cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy
      let S := cyclicBasisAt Y vy * cyclicBasisAtInv X vx
      T * S = 1 ∧ S * T = 1 ∧ X * T = T * Y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.bottomLeft_skew
statement:
theorem bottomLeft_skew {P : Mat6 K} (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) :
    (bottomLeft P).transpose = -bottomLeft P

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.bottomRight_eq_transpose_topLeft
statement:
theorem bottomRight_eq_transpose_topLeft {P : Mat6 K}
    (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) : bottomRight P = (topLeft P).transpose

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.carrier_property
statement: theorem carrier_property (P : Carrier K) : IsSelfAdjoint (P : Mat6 K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.coe_jordan
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_jordan (A B : Carrier K) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.coe_one
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_one : ((one : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.exists_grouped
statement:
theorem exists_grouped (P : Carrier K) :
    ∃ a u v, (P : Mat6 K) = grouped a u v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.grouped_extract
statement:
theorem grouped_extract (P : Mat6 K) (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) :
    grouped (topLeft P) (unhat (topRight P)) (unhat (bottomLeft P)) = P

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.grouped_injective
statement:
theorem grouped_injective
    {a a' : Mat3 K} {u v u' v' : Vec3 K}
    (h : grouped a u v = grouped a' u' v') :
    a = a' ∧ u = u' ∧ v = v'

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.hat_unhat_of_skew
statement:
theorem hat_unhat_of_skew (B : Mat3 K) (hB : B.transpose = -B) :
    hat (unhat B) = B

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.matrixJordan_mem
AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.topRight_skew
statement:
theorem topRight_skew {P : Mat6 K} (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) :
    (topRight P).transpose = -topRight P

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.unhat_hat
statement: @[simp] theorem unhat_hat (u : Vec3 K) : unhat (hat u) = u

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarJordanAut.actLinear_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem actLinear_coe (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (P : Carrier K) :
    ((actLinear t ht P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) =
      scalarSimilitude t * P * scalarSimilitudeInv t

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarJordanAut.conjugate_mem
statement:
theorem conjugate_mem (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (P : Carrier K) :
    IsSelfAdjoint
      (scalarSimilitude t * (P : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarJordanAut.scalarAut_grouped
statement:
@[simp] theorem scalarAut_grouped
    (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (a : ScalarFibre.Mat3 K)
    (u v : ScalarFibre.Vec3 K)
    (P : Carrier K) (hP : (P : Mat6 K) = grouped a u v) :
    (((scalarAut t ht).linear P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) =
      grouped a (t • u) (t⁻¹ • v)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.conjugateLinear_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugateLinear_coe
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ) (P : Carrier K) :
    ((conjugateLinear M N hMN hform P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = M * P * N

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.conjugate_map_jordan
statement:
theorem conjugate_map_jordan
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hNM : N * M = 1) (A B : Mat6 K) :
    M * matrixJordan A B * N =
      matrixJordan (M * A * N) (M * B * N)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.conjugate_map_one
statement:
theorem conjugate_map_one
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1) : M * (1 : Mat6 K) * N = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.conjugate_mem
statement:
theorem conjugate_mem
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ)
    (P : Carrier K) : IsSelfAdjoint (M * (P : Mat6 K) * N)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.inverse_is_symplectic
statement:
theorem inverse_is_symplectic
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ) :
    N.transpose * symplecticJ * N = symplecticJ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.left_form_of_symplectic_inverse
statement:
theorem left_form_of_symplectic_inverse
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ) :
    M.transpose * symplecticJ = symplecticJ * N

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.right_form_of_symplectic_inverse
statement:
theorem right_form_of_symplectic_inverse
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ) :
    N.transpose * symplecticJ = symplecticJ * M

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeConjugation.conjugateLinear_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugateLinear_coe (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = c • symplecticJ) (P : Carrier K) :
    ((conjugateLinear M N c hMN hform P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = M * P * N

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeConjugation.conjugate_mem
statement:
theorem conjugate_mem (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = c • symplecticJ)
    (P : Carrier K) : IsSelfAdjoint (M * (P : Mat6 K) * N)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeConjugation.inverse_form
statement:
theorem inverse_form (hMN : M * N = 1) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = c • symplecticJ) :
    N.transpose * symplecticJ * N = c⁻¹ • symplecticJ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeConjugation.left_form
statement:
theorem left_form (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = c • symplecticJ) :
    M.transpose * symplecticJ = c • (symplecticJ * N)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeConjugation.scaled_right_form
statement:
theorem scaled_right_form (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = c • symplecticJ) :
    c • (N.transpose * symplecticJ) = symplecticJ * M

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.adjugate_of_actual_projector
statement:
theorem adjugate_of_actual_projector
    (P : Carrier K) (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K)
    (hP : (P : Mat6 K) = grouped a u v)
    (hidem : (P : Mat6 K) * P = P)
    (htrace : jordanTrace (K := K) (P : Mat6 K) = 1) :
    Matrix.adjugate a = -outer v u

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.grouped_trace_one
statement:
theorem grouped_trace_one
    (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K)
    (htrace : jordanTrace (grouped a u v) = 1) : Matrix.trace a = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.jordanTrace_grouped
statement:
@[simp] theorem jordanTrace_grouped (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K) :
    jordanTrace (grouped a u v) = Matrix.trace a

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.same_a_actual_projector_fibre
statement:
theorem same_a_actual_projector_fibre
    (P P' : Carrier K) (a : Mat3 K) (u v u' v' : Vec3 K)
    (hP : (P : Mat6 K) = grouped a u v)
    (hP' : (P' : Mat6 K) = grouped a u' v')
    (hidem : (P : Mat6 K) * P = P)
    (hidem' : (P' : Mat6 K) * P' = P')
    (htrace : jordanTrace (K := K) (P : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hadj : Matrix.adjugate a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧ u' = t • u ∧ v' = t⁻¹ • v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.top_left_projector_equation
statement:
theorem top_left_projector_equation
    (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K)
    (hidem : grouped a u v * grouped a u v = grouped a u v) :
    a * a - a = -(hat u * hat v)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.trace_grouped
statement:
theorem trace_grouped (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K) :
    Matrix.trace (grouped a u v) = 2 * Matrix.trace a

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.equiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_apply
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) (x : V) :
    equiv omega halt d t x = x + (t * omega d x) • d

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.equiv_preserves
statement:
theorem equiv_preserves
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) (x y : V) :
    omega (equiv omega halt d t x) (equiv omega halt d t y) = omega x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.equiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_symm_apply
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) (x : V) :
    (equiv omega halt d t).symm x = x + ((-t) * omega d x) • d

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.map_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_apply
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (d : V) (t : K) (x : V) :
    map omega d t x = x + (t * omega d x) • d

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.map_comp_neg
statement:
theorem map_comp_neg
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) :
    (map omega d t).comp (map omega d (-t)) = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.map_neg_comp
statement:
theorem map_neg_comp
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) :
    (map omega d (-t)).comp (map omega d t) = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.map_preserves
statement:
theorem map_preserves
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) (x y : V) :
    omega (map omega d t x) (map omega d t y) = omega x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.one_step_align
statement:
theorem one_step_align
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x y : V)
    (hpair : omega y x ≠ 0) :
    equiv omega halt (y - x) (omega y x)⁻¹ x = y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.skew_of_alternating
statement:
theorem skew_of_alternating
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x y : V) :
    omega x y = -omega y x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.two_step_align
statement:
theorem two_step_align
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0) :
    equiv omega halt (y - z) (omega y z)⁻¹
      (equiv omega halt (z - x) (omega z x)⁻¹ x) = y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal
statement:
theorem comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal
    (P Q : V →ₗ[K] V) (hP : IsIdempotent P) (hQ : IsIdempotent Q)
    (hPQ : IsJordanOrthogonal P Q) : P.comp Q = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.different_images_orthogonal
statement:
theorem different_images_orthogonal
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (P Q : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hself : IsSelfAdjoint omega P) (hcomp : P.comp Q = 0)
    (x y : V) : omega (P x) (Q y) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.idempotent_apply
statement:
theorem idempotent_apply (P : V →ₗ[K] V) (hP : IsIdempotent P) (x : V) :
    P (P x) = P x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.jordan_orthogonal_apply
statement:
theorem jordan_orthogonal_apply (P Q : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hPQ : IsJordanOrthogonal P Q) (x : V) :
    P (Q x) + Q (P x) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.normalizedPartner_mem
statement:
theorem normalizedPartner_mem
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (P : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hP : IsIdempotent P) (u y : V) :
    P (normalizedPartner omega P u y) = normalizedPartner omega P u y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.normalizedPartner_pairs_one
statement:
theorem normalizedPartner_pairs_one
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (P : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hP : IsIdempotent P) (hself : IsSelfAdjoint omega P) (x y : V)
    (hpair : omega (P x) y ≠ 0) :
    omega (P x) (normalizedPartner omega P (P x) y) = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.reverse_comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal
statement:
theorem reverse_comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal
    (P Q : V →ₗ[K] V) (hP : IsIdempotent P) (hQ : IsIdempotent Q)
    (hPQ : IsJordanOrthogonal P Q) : Q.comp P = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.projectPair_pairing_left
statement:
theorem projectPair_pairing_left
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (e f c q : V)
    (hqe : omega q e = 0) (hqf : omega q f = 0) :
    omega q (projectPair omega e f c) = omega q c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.projectPair_pairing_right
statement:
theorem projectPair_pairing_right
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (e f c q : V)
    (heq : omega e q = 0) (hfq : omega f q = 0) :
    omega (projectPair omega e f c) q = omega c q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.projectPairs_pairing_left
statement:
theorem projectPairs_pairing_left
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (pairs : List (V × V)) (c q : V)
    (hortho : ∀ pair ∈ pairs, omega q pair.1 = 0 ∧ omega q pair.2 = 0) :
    omega q (projectPairs omega pairs c) = omega q c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.projectPairs_pairing_right
statement:
theorem projectPairs_pairing_right
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (pairs : List (V × V)) (c q : V)
    (hortho : ∀ pair ∈ pairs, omega pair.1 q = 0 ∧ omega pair.2 q = 0) :
    omega (projectPairs omega pairs c) q = omega c q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_common_detour
statement:
theorem exists_common_detour
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (x y : V) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z, omega z x ≠ 0 ∧ omega y z ≠ 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_two_step_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_two_step_alignment
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (x y : V) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z,
      equiv omega halt (y - z) (omega y z)⁻¹
        (equiv omega halt (z - x) (omega z x)⁻¹ x) = y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.fixedTwelveMap_preserves
statement:
theorem fixedTwelveMap_preserves
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (schedule : FixedTwelveSchedule (K := K) (V := V)) (x y : V) :
    omega (fixedTwelveMap omega schedule x) (fixedTwelveMap omega schedule y) =
      omega x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.map_zero_parameter
statement:
theorem map_zero_parameter
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (d : V) :
    map omega d 0 = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.wordMap_append
statement:
theorem wordMap_append
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (left right : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) :
    wordMap omega (left ++ right) =
      (wordMap omega left).comp (wordMap omega right)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.wordMap_cons_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordMap_cons_apply
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (d : V) (t : K)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) (x : V) :
    wordMap omega ((d, t) :: word) x = map omega d t (wordMap omega word x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.wordMap_fixes_of_centers
statement:
theorem wordMap_fixes_of_centers
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) (q : V)
    (hfix : ∀ step ∈ word, omega step.1 q = 0) :
    wordMap omega word q = q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.wordMap_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordMap_nil
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) :
    wordMap omega [] = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.wordMap_preserves
statement:
theorem wordMap_preserves
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) (x y : V) :
    omega (wordMap omega word x) (wordMap omega word y) = omega x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.wordMap_zero_parameters
statement:
theorem wordMap_zero_parameters
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (directions : List V) :
    wordMap omega (directions.map fun d => (d, (0 : K))) = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.avoidanceScalar_ne
statement: theorem avoidanceScalar_ne (c : K) : avoidanceScalar c ≠ c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.avoidanceScalar_ne_zero
statement: theorem avoidanceScalar_ne_zero (c : K) : avoidanceScalar c ≠ 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.partner_centers_fix_first
statement:
theorem partner_centers_fix_first
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (e v f : V)
    (hev : omega e v = 1) (hef : omega e f = 1) (a : K) :
    omega ((v + a • e) - v) e = 0 ∧
      omega (f - (v + a • e)) e = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.partner_intermediate_pairings
statement:
theorem partner_intermediate_pairings
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (e v f : V)
    (hev : omega e v = 1) (hef : omega e f = 1) (a : K) :
    omega (v + a • e) v = a ∧
      omega f (v + a • e) = omega f v - a

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.partner_two_step_align
statement:
theorem partner_two_step_align
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (e v f : V)
    (hev : omega e v = 1) (hef : omega e f = 1) :
    let a := avoidanceScalar (omega f v)
    let w := v + a • e
    equiv omega halt (f - w) (omega f w)⁻¹
      (equiv omega halt (w - v) (omega w v)⁻¹ v) = f

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.partner_two_step_fixes_first
statement:
theorem partner_two_step_fixes_first
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (e v f : V)
    (hev : omega e v = 1) (hef : omega e f = 1) :
    let a := avoidanceScalar (omega f v)
    let w := v + a • e
    equiv omega halt (f - w) (omega f w)⁻¹
      (equiv omega halt (w - v) (omega w v)⁻¹ e) = e

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.firstAlignment_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstAlignment_apply
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0) (q : V) :
    firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy q =
      equiv omega halt (y - z) (omega y z)⁻¹
        (equiv omega halt (z - x) (omega z x)⁻¹ q)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.firstAlignment_preserves
statement:
theorem firstAlignment_preserves
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0) (q r : V) :
    omega (firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy q)
      (firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy r) = omega q r

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.firstAlignment_source
statement:
theorem firstAlignment_source
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0) :
    firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy x = y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.fourStepPairWord_partner
statement:
theorem fourStepPairWord_partner
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y v f : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0)
    (hxv : omega x v = 1) (hyf : omega y f = 1) :
    wordMap omega (fourStepPairWord omega halt x z y v f hxz hzy) v = f

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.fourStepPairWord_source
statement:
theorem fourStepPairWord_source
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y v f : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0)
    (hxv : omega x v = 1) (hyf : omega y f = 1) :
    wordMap omega (fourStepPairWord omega halt x z y v f hxz hzy) x = y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.common_detour_of_two_witnesses
statement:
theorem common_detour_of_two_witnesses
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (x y zx zy : V)
    (hzx : omega zx x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y zy ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z ∈ [zx, zy, zx + zy], omega z x ≠ 0 ∧ omega y z ≠ 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.fourStepPairWord_fixes
statement:
theorem fourStepPairWord_fixes
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y v f q : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0)
    (hxq : omega x q = 0) (hzq : omega z q = 0)
    (hyq : omega y q = 0) (hvq : omega v q = 0)
    (hfq : omega f q = 0) :
    wordMap omega (fourStepPairWord omega halt x z y v f hxz hzy) q = q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.projectPair_orthogonal
statement:
theorem projectPair_orthogonal
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (e f c : V)
    (hef : omega e f = 1) :
    omega (projectPair omega e f c) e = 0 ∧
      omega (projectPair omega e f c) f = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_detour_orthogonal_one_pair
statement:
theorem exists_detour_orthogonal_one_pair
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (e f x y : V) (hef : omega e f = 1)
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hex : omega e x = 0) (hfx : omega f x = 0)
    (hye : omega y e = 0) (hyf : omega y f = 0) :
    ∃ z, omega z x ≠ 0 ∧ omega y z ≠ 0 ∧
      omega z e = 0 ∧ omega z f = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_detour_orthogonal_two_pairs
statement:
theorem exists_detour_orthogonal_two_pairs
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (e0 f0 e1 f1 x y : V) (hef0 : omega e0 f0 = 1)
    (hef1 : omega e1 f1 = 1) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (h10e : omega e1 e0 = 0) (h10f : omega f1 e0 = 0)
    (h11e : omega e1 f0 = 0) (h11f : omega f1 f0 = 0)
    (he0x : omega e0 x = 0) (hf0x : omega f0 x = 0)
    (he1x : omega e1 x = 0) (hf1x : omega f1 x = 0)
    (hye0 : omega y e0 = 0) (hyf0 : omega y f0 = 0)
    (hye1 : omega y e1 = 0) (hyf1 : omega y f1 = 0) :
    ∃ z, omega z x ≠ 0 ∧ omega y z ≠ 0 ∧
      omega z e0 = 0 ∧ omega z f0 = 0 ∧
      omega z e1 = 0 ∧ omega z f1 = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_four_step_fixing_one_pair
statement:
theorem exists_four_step_fixing_one_pair
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (e0 f0 x v y f : V) (he0f0 : omega e0 f0 = 1)
    (hxv : omega x v = 1) (hyf : omega y f = 1)
    (he0x : omega e0 x = 0) (hf0x : omega f0 x = 0)
    (he0v : omega e0 v = 0) (hf0v : omega f0 v = 0)
    (hye0 : omega y e0 = 0) (hyf0 : omega y f0 = 0)
    (hfe0 : omega f e0 = 0) (hff0 : omega f f0 = 0) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V)), word.length = 4 ∧
      wordMap omega word x = y ∧ wordMap omega word v = f ∧
      wordMap omega word e0 = e0 ∧ wordMap omega word f0 = f0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_four_step_fixing_two_pairs
statement:
theorem exists_four_step_fixing_two_pairs
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (e0 f0 e1 f1 x v y f : V)
    (he0f0 : omega e0 f0 = 1) (he1f1 : omega e1 f1 = 1)
    (hxv : omega x v = 1) (hyf : omega y f = 1)
    (he1e0 : omega e1 e0 = 0) (hf1e0 : omega f1 e0 = 0)
    (he1f0 : omega e1 f0 = 0) (hf1f0 : omega f1 f0 = 0)
    (he0x : omega e0 x = 0) (hf0x : omega f0 x = 0)
    (he1x : omega e1 x = 0) (hf1x : omega f1 x = 0)
    (he0v : omega e0 v = 0) (hf0v : omega f0 v = 0)
    (he1v : omega e1 v = 0) (hf1v : omega f1 v = 0)
    (hye0 : omega y e0 = 0) (hyf0 : omega y f0 = 0)
    (hye1 : omega y e1 = 0) (hyf1 : omega y f1 = 0)
    (hfe0 : omega f e0 = 0) (hff0 : omega f f0 = 0)
    (hfe1 : omega f e1 = 0) (hff1 : omega f f1 = 0) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V)), word.length = 4 ∧
      wordMap omega word x = y ∧ wordMap omega word v = f ∧
      wordMap omega word e0 = e0 ∧ wordMap omega word f0 = f0 ∧
      wordMap omega word e1 = e1 ∧ wordMap omega word f1 = f1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_four_step_pair
statement:
theorem exists_four_step_pair
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (x v y f : V) (hxv : omega x v = 1) (hyf : omega y f = 1) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V)), word.length = 4 ∧
      wordMap omega word x = y ∧ wordMap omega word v = f

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.comp_zero_of_complete_frame
statement:
theorem comp_zero_of_complete_frame (P : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hidem : ∀ i, IsIdempotent (P i))
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = LinearMap.id) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (P i).comp (P j) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.exists_image_hyperbolic_pair
statement:
theorem exists_image_hyperbolic_pair
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega) (P : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hP : IsIdempotent P) (hself : IsSelfAdjoint omega P) (hne : P ≠ 0) :
    ∃ u v : V, P u = u ∧ P v = v ∧ omega u v = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.first_two_comp_zero_of_sum
statement:
theorem first_two_comp_zero_of_sum (A B C : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hA : IsIdempotent A) (hB : IsIdempotent B) (hC : IsIdempotent C)
    (hsum : A + B + C = LinearMap.id) : A.comp B = 0 ∧ B.comp A = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.carrier_action_ne_zero_of_trace_one
statement:
theorem carrier_action_ne_zero_of_trace_one (P : Carrier K)
    (htrace : jordanTrace (K := K) (P : Mat6 K) = 1) :
    matrixAction (K := K) (P : Mat6 K) ≠ 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.carrier_action_selfAdjoint
statement:
theorem carrier_action_selfAdjoint (P : Carrier K) :
    SymplecticProjectorFrame.IsSelfAdjoint (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (K := K) (P : Mat6 K))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.carrier_frame_action_sum
statement:
theorem carrier_frame_action_sum
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    matrixAction (K := K) (P 0 : Mat6 K) +
        matrixAction (K := K) (P 1 : Mat6 K) +
        matrixAction (K := K) (P 2 : Mat6 K) =
      LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.carrier_projector_action_idempotent
statement:
theorem carrier_projector_action_idempotent (P : Carrier K)
    (hP : (P : Mat6 K) * P = P) :
    SymplecticProjectorFrame.IsIdempotent
      (matrixAction (K := K) (P : Mat6 K))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_add
statement:
theorem matrixAction_add (P Q : Mat6 K) :
    matrixAction (P + Q) = matrixAction P + matrixAction Q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixAction_apply (P : Mat6 K) (x : Vec6 K) (i : Ix6) :
    matrixAction P x i = ∑ j, P i j * x j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_injective
statement: theorem matrixAction_injective : Function.Injective (matrixAction (K := K))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_mul
statement:
theorem matrixAction_mul (P Q : Mat6 K) :
    matrixAction (P * Q) = (matrixAction P).comp (matrixAction Q)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_one
statement: theorem matrixAction_one : matrixAction (1 : Mat6 K) = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_zero
statement: theorem matrixAction_zero : matrixAction (0 : Mat6 K) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega_alternating
statement: theorem omega_alternating (x : Vec6 K) : (omega (K := K)) x x = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega_basis_pair
statement:
theorem omega_basis_pair (i : Fin 3) :
    (omega (K := K)) (basisVector (Sum.inl i))
      (basisVector (Sum.inr i)) = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega_left_nondegenerate
statement: theorem omega_left_nondegenerate : IsLeftNondegenerate (omega (K := K))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega_right_nondegenerate
statement: theorem omega_right_nondegenerate : IsRightNondegenerate (omega (K := K))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.intertwines_of_spanning_target
statement:
theorem intertwines_of_spanning_target
    (L : V →ₗ[K] V) (hL : Function.Injective L)
    (P Q : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] V) (u v e f : Fin 3 → V)
    (hLu : ∀ j, L (u j) = e j) (hLv : ∀ j, L (v j) = f j)
    (hPu : ∀ i j, P i (u j) = if i = j then u j else 0)
    (hPv : ∀ i j, P i (v j) = if i = j then v j else 0)
    (hQe : ∀ i j, Q i (e j) = if i = j then e j else 0)
    (hQf : ∀ i j, Q i (f j) = if i = j then f j else 0)
    (hspan : ∀ z : V, ∃ a b : Fin 3 → K,
      z = (∑ j, a j • e j) + ∑ j, b j • f j) :
    ∀ i, L.comp (P i) = (Q i).comp L

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.wordMap_injective
statement:
theorem wordMap_injective
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) :
    Function.Injective (wordMap omega word)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.fixedTwelveMap_scheduleOfLengthTwelve
statement:
theorem fixedTwelveMap_scheduleOfLengthTwelve
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) (hlen : word.length = 12) :
    fixedTwelveMap omega (scheduleOfLengthTwelve word hlen) = wordMap omega word

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.ofFn_scheduleOfLengthTwelve
statement:
theorem ofFn_scheduleOfLengthTwelve
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) (hlen : word.length = 12) :
    List.ofFn (scheduleOfLengthTwelve word hlen) = word

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.exists_literal_twelve_actual_carrier_frame_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_literal_twelve_actual_carrier_frame_alignment
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) ((P i : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∃ schedule : FixedTwelveSchedule (K := K) (V := Vec6 K),
      ∀ i, (fixedTwelveMap omega schedule).comp (matrixAction (P i)) =
        (standardProjector i).comp (fixedTwelveMap omega schedule)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.exists_twelve_actual_carrier_frame_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_twelve_actual_carrier_frame_alignment
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) ((P i : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)), word.length = 12 ∧
      ∀ i, (wordMap omega word).comp (matrixAction (P i)) =
        (standardProjector i).comp (wordMap omega word)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.standardProjector_E
statement:
theorem standardProjector_E (i j : Fin 3) :
    standardProjector (K := K) i (standardE j) =
      if i = j then standardE j else 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.standardProjector_F
statement:
theorem standardProjector_F (i j : Fin 3) :
    standardProjector (K := K) i (standardF j) =
      if i = j then standardF j else 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.standard_spans
statement:
theorem standard_spans (x : Vec6 K) :
    ∃ a b : Fin 3 → K,
      x = (∑ j, a j • standardE j) + ∑ j, b j • standardF j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.exists_actual_weighted_first_projector_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_actual_weighted_first_projector_coordinates
    (E F : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (E i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (F i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1) :
    ∃ u v : Vec6 K,
      matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) u = u ∧
      matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) v = v ∧ (omega (K := K)) u v = 1 ∧
      let p : Fin 3 → K := fun i => (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
      (∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u) ∧
      (∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v) ∧
      (∀ i, (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.scalar_compression_on_hyperbolic_image
statement:
theorem scalar_compression_on_hyperbolic_image
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (F E : V →ₗ[K] V) (hFidem : IsIdempotent F)
    (hFself : IsSelfAdjoint omega F) (hEself : IsSelfAdjoint omega E)
    (u v : V) (hFu : F u = u) (hFv : F v = v)
    (huv : omega u v = 1) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hspan : ∀ x, F x = x → ∃ a b : K, x = a • u + b • v) :
    let p := omega (E u) v
    F (E u) = p • u ∧ F (E v) = p • v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.carrier_frame_images_orthogonal
statement:
theorem carrier_frame_images_orthogonal
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    {i j : Fin 3} (hij : i ≠ j) (x y : Vec6 K) :
    (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) x)
      (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) y) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weightedCoordinateLinear_injective
statement:
theorem weightedCoordinateLinear_injective
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weighted_coordinates_injective
statement:
theorem weighted_coordinates_injective
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (a b : Fin 3 → K)
    (hz : (∑ i, a i • matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) +
      ∑ i, b i • matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v = 0) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weighted_pairings
statement:
theorem weighted_pairings
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) :
    (∀ i j, (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) v) = if i = j then p i else 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) u) = 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
        (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) v) = 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.inverseWord_left
statement:
theorem inverseWord_left
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    (wordMap omega (inverseWord word)).comp (wordMap omega word) = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.inverseWord_right
statement:
theorem inverseWord_right
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    (wordMap omega word).comp (wordMap omega (inverseWord word)) = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.inverse_mul_wordMatrix
statement:
theorem inverse_mul_wordMatrix (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    inverseWordMatrix word * wordMatrix word = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.matrixAction_basisVector
statement:
theorem matrixAction_basisVector (M : Mat6 K) (j : Ix6) :
    matrixAction (K := K) M (basisVector (K := K) j) = fun i => M i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.matrixAction_matrixOfLinear
statement:
theorem matrixAction_matrixOfLinear (L : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) :
    matrixAction (matrixOfLinear L) = L

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.matrix_symplectic_of_action_preserves
statement:
theorem matrix_symplectic_of_action_preserves
    (M : Mat6 K)
    (hpres : ∀ x y : Vec6 K,
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (K := K) M x) (matrixAction (K := K) M y) =
        (omega (K := K)) x y) :
    M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.omega_basisVector
statement:
theorem omega_basisVector (i j : Ix6) :
    (omega (K := K)) (basisVector (K := K) i) (basisVector (K := K) j) =
      symplecticJ i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.symplectic_product_entry
statement:
theorem symplectic_product_entry (M : Mat6 K) (i j : Ix6) :
    ((M.transpose * (symplecticJ : Mat6 K) * M) : Mat6 K) i j =
      (omega (K := K)) (fun r => M r i) (fun r => M r j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.wordMatrix_mul_inverse
statement:
theorem wordMatrix_mul_inverse (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    wordMatrix word * inverseWordMatrix word = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.wordMatrix_symplectic
statement:
theorem wordMatrix_symplectic (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    (wordMatrix word).transpose * symplecticJ * wordMatrix word = symplecticJ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.commonPlaneMap_comp
statement:
theorem commonPlaneMap_comp (T S : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K)
    (hTS : T * S = 1) :
    (commonPlaneMap T).comp (commonPlaneMap S) = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.commonPlaneMap_form
statement:
theorem commonPlaneMap_form (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (T : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) (x y : Vec6 K) :
    weightedOmega p (commonPlaneMap T x) (commonPlaneMap T y) =
      det2 T * weightedOmega p x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weightedCoordinate_form
statement:
theorem weightedCoordinate_form
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (x y : Vec6 K) :
    (omega (K := K)) (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v x)
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v y) = weightedOmega p x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.all_blocks_diagonal
statement:
theorem all_blocks_diagonal
    (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K) (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hd : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (H S : Mat2 K) (hSH : S * H = 1) (sigma : K)
    (hX : S * B 0 1 * H = eigenvalues (B 0 1) sigma) :
    ∀ i j, (S * B i j * H) 0 1 = 0 ∧ (S * B i j * H) 1 0 = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.all_blocks_killed
statement:
theorem all_blocks_killed
    (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K) (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hd : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (ell : Mat2 K →ₗ[K] K) (hI : ell 1 = 0) (hX : ell (B 0 1) = 0) :
    ∀ i j, ell (B i j) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.cyclicSplitBasis_det
statement:
theorem cyclicSplitBasis_det (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K) (v : Vec2 K)
    (hs : sigma ≠ 0) (hv : cyclicDet X v ≠ 0) :
    determinant (cyclicSplitBasis X sigma v) = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.cyclicSplitBasis_intertwines
statement:
theorem cyclicSplitBasis_intertwines (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K) (v : Vec2 K)
    (hroot : sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    X * cyclicSplitBasis X sigma v =
      cyclicSplitBasis X sigma v * eigenvalues X sigma

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.eigenCoefficients_det
statement:
theorem eigenCoefficients_det (X : Mat2 K) (sigma d : K)
    (hs : sigma ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    determinant (eigenCoefficients X sigma d) = d⁻¹

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.eigenCoefficients_intertwines
statement:
theorem eigenCoefficients_intertwines (X : Mat2 K) (sigma d : K)
    (hroot : sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    companion X * eigenCoefficients X sigma d =
      eigenCoefficients X sigma d * eigenvalues X sigma

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.exists_ordered_sl2_split
statement:
theorem exists_ordered_sl2_split (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K)
    (hs : sigma ≠ 0)
    (hroot : sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    ∃ H S : Mat2 K,
      determinant H = 1 ∧ H * S = 1 ∧ S * H = 1 ∧
      S * X * H = eigenvalues X sigma

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.inverseSL_mul
statement:
theorem inverseSL_mul (H : Mat2 K) (hH : determinant H = 1) :
    inverseSL H * H = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.mul_inverseSL
statement:
theorem mul_inverseSL (H : Mat2 K) (hH : determinant H = 1) :
    H * inverseSL H = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.planeScale_comp
statement:
theorem planeScale_comp (t s : Fin 3 → K) (h : ∀ i, t i * s i = 1) :
    (planeScale t).comp (planeScale s) = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.planeScale_weighted_form
statement:
theorem planeScale_weighted_form (p : Fin 3 → K) (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (x y : Vec6 K) :
    weightedOmega p (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) x)
      (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) y) = (omega (K := K)) x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.splitForward_symplectic
statement:
theorem splitForward_symplectic
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (H : Mat2 K) (hH : determinant H = 1) :
    let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let Q := matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)
    Q.transpose * symplecticJ * Q = symplecticJ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.split_inverse
statement:
theorem split_inverse (L : Vec6 K ≃ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (H S : Mat2 K) (hHS : H * S = 1) (hSH : S * H = 1) :
    (splitForward L p H).comp (splitBackward L p S) = LinearMap.id ∧
    (splitBackward L p S).comp (splitForward L p H) = LinearMap.id

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.first_projector_intertwines_weighted_coordinates
statement:
theorem first_projector_intertwines_weighted_coordinates
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F0 : Carrier K)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v) :
    (matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)).comp (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v) =
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v).comp (weightedFirstAction p)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.matrixAction_weightedFirstMatrix
statement:
theorem matrixAction_weightedFirstMatrix (p : Fin 3 → K) :
    matrixAction (weightedFirstMatrix p) = weightedFirstAction p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.actual_second_projector_weighted_zero_compositions
statement:
theorem actual_second_projector_weighted_zero_compositions
    (E F : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v) :
    let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))
    B.comp (weightedFirstAction p) = 0 ∧
      (weightedFirstAction p).comp B = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.actual_weighted_block_adjoint
statement:
theorem actual_weighted_block_adjoint
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F1 : Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) :
    let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))
    ∀ i j, p i • weightedBlock B i j = p j • adj2 (weightedBlock B j i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.actual_weighted_diagonal_scalar
statement:
theorem actual_weighted_diagonal_scalar
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F1 : Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) :
    let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))
    ∀ i, ∃ q : K, weightedBlock B i i = scalar2 q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.coordinateConjugate_comp
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_comp
    (L : Vec6 K ≃ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (A B : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) :
    coordinateConjugate L (A.comp B) =
      (coordinateConjugate L A).comp (coordinateConjugate L B)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.coordinateConjugate_first_projector
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_first_projector
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F0 : Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v) :
    coordinateConjugate
      (weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne)
      (matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)) = weightedFirstAction p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.coordinateConjugate_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_zero
    (L : Vec6 K ≃ₗ[K] Vec6 K) :
    coordinateConjugate L (0 : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) = 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_left
statement:
theorem weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_left
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (u v : Vec6 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (basisVector (Sum.inl i)) =
      matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_right
statement:
theorem weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_right
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (u v : Vec6 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (basisVector (Sum.inr i)) =
      matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weighted_block_zero_sums
statement:
theorem weighted_block_zero_sums
    (B : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K) (hp0 : p 0 ≠ 0)
    (hrow : B.comp (weightedFirstAction p) = 0)
    (hcol : (weightedFirstAction p).comp B = 0) :
    (∀ i r s, ∑ j, weightedBlock B i j r s = 0) ∧
      (∀ j r s, ∑ i, p i * weightedBlock B i j r s = 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weighted_pairing_extract
statement:
theorem weighted_pairing_extract
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (z : Vec6 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    (omega (K := K)) (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z)
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = z (Sum.inl i) * p i ∧
      (omega (K := K)) (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z)
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = -(z (Sum.inr i) * p i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weighted_pairing_extract_reverse
statement:
theorem weighted_pairing_extract_reverse
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (z : Vec6 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z) = z (Sum.inr i) * p i ∧
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
        (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z) = -(z (Sum.inl i) * p i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.coordinateConjugate_first_frame
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_first_frame
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    coordinateConjugate
      (weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K)) = standardProjector i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.diagonal_scalar_eq_actual_pair_ledger
statement:
theorem diagonal_scalar_eq_actual_pair_ledger
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F1 : Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.actual_common_splitter_of_cyclic_vector
statement:
theorem actual_common_splitter_of_cyclic_vector
    (E F : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (w : Vec2 K) (sigma : K) (hs : sigma ≠ 0)
    (hroot : let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let X := weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1
      sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X)
    (hw : let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let X := weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1
      cyclicDet X w ≠ 0) :
    let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let X := weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1
    let H := cyclicSplitBasis X sigma w
    let S := inverseSL H
    let Q := matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)
    let N := matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S)
    ∃ f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K,
      Q * N = 1 ∧ N * Q = 1 ∧ Q.transpose * symplecticJ * Q = symplecticJ ∧
      (∀ i, N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0) ∧
      (∀ j, N * (F j : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (f j) 0 0)

statement:
theorem actual_same_ledger_weighted_pair_data

    (u v u' v' : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hp' : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u')
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v')) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (hFu' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') = p i • u')
    (hFv' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v') = p i • v')
    (hledger : ∀ i,
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 1 : Mat6 K)) =
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E' i : Mat6 K) * (F' 1 : Mat6 K))) :
    let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let L' := weightedCoordinateEquiv E' hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne

      (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
    let C := fun i j => weightedBlock
      (coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (F' 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
    ∃ q : Fin 3 → K,
      (∀ i, B i i = scalar2 (q i)) ∧
      (∀ i, C i i = scalar2 (q i)) ∧
      (∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0) ∧
      (∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0) ∧
      (∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, p i • B i j = p j • adj2 (B j i)) ∧
      (∀ i j, p i • C i j = p j • adj2 (C j i))

statement:

    (hpne : ∀ i,
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) ≠ 0)
    (hp12 :
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E 1 : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) +
        jordanTrace (K := K) ((E 2 : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) ≠ 0)
    (hdisc : ∀ (u v : Vec6 K)

      trace2 (B 0 1) ^ 2 - 4 * determinant (B 0 1) ≠ 0) :

statement:
theorem commonPlaneForwardBackward_matrix_laws
    (E E' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)

    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i)
    (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (u v u' v' : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hp' : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v'))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (S T : Mat2 K) (hST : S * T = 1) (hTS : T * S = 1) :
    let A := matrixOfLinear
      (commonPlaneForward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
        u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S)
    let B := matrixOfLinear
      (commonPlaneBackward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
        u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne T)
    A * B = 1 ∧ B * A = 1 ∧
      A.transpose * symplecticJ * A = det2 S • symplecticJ

      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v')) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (hFu' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') = p i • u')
    (hFv' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v') = p i • v')

    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (F1 : Carrier K) (r s : Fin 2) :
    let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1 r s =
      coordinateConjugateFormula
        (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
        (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))
        (basisVector (weightedPairIndex 1 s)) (weightedPairIndex 0 r)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedInverseCoordinates.weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_apply
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (w : Vec6 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    (L.symm w) (Sum.inl i) =
        -((omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) w) * (p i)⁻¹ ∧
      (L.symm w) (Sum.inr i) =
        (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) w * (p i)⁻¹

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedInverseCoordinates.weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_eq_formula
statement:
theorem weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_eq_formula
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (w : Vec6 K) :
    let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    L.symm w = weightedInverseFormula
      (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
      (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) w

theorem overlap_triples_gauge_related
    (U V W U' V' W' : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → K)
    (hUnz : ∀ i j, U i j ≠ 0) (hVnz : ∀ j l, V j l ≠ 0)
    (hWnz : ∀ l i, W l i ≠ 0)
    (hUsq : ∀ i j, (U' i j) ^ 2 = (U i j) ^ 2)
    (hVsq : ∀ j l, (V' j l) ^ 2 = (V j l) ^ 2)
    (hWsq : ∀ l i, (W' l i) ^ 2 = (W l i) ^ 2)
    (hC : ∀ i j l, U' i j * V' j l * W' l i =
      U i j * V j l * W l i) :
    ∃ epsilon eta zeta : Fin 3 → K,
      (∀ i, (epsilon i) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ j, (eta j) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ l, (zeta l) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ i j, U' i j = epsilon i * U i j * eta j) ∧
      (∀ j l, V' j l = eta j * V j l * zeta l) ∧
      (∀ l i, W' l i = zeta l * W l i * epsilon i)

    (hr : ∀ l i, (r l i) ^ 2 = 1)
    (htriangle : ∀ i j l, s i j * t j l * r l i = 1) :
    ∃ epsilon eta zeta : Fin 3 → K,
      (∀ i, (epsilon i) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ j, (eta j) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ l, (zeta l) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ i j, s i j = epsilon i * eta j) ∧
      (∀ j l, t j l = eta j * zeta l) ∧
      (∀ l i, r l i = zeta l * epsilon i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorPairFiniteDephase.exists_common_field_sourceAut
statement:
theorem exists_common_field_sourceAut
    (x y : JCoord K) (ha : nV x.v ≠ 0)
    (hGram : 4*nV x.v*nV y.v - (BV x.v y.v)^2 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L)
      (f : K →+* L) (sigma : L) (g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := L)),
      Function.Injective f ∧
      sigma ^ 2 = f ((BV x.v y.v)^2 - 4*nV x.v*nV y.v) ∧
      sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ z : JCoord L,
        ((g.linear z).d1,(g.linear z).d2,(g.linear z).d3) = (z.d1,z.d2,z.d3)) ∧
      (g.linear (mapSource f x)).v = targetFirst (f (nV x.v)) ∧
      (g.linear (mapSource f y)).v =
        targetSecond (f (nV x.v)) (f (BV x.v y.v)) sigma

name: FrameInvariants.GenericTransfer.quadratic_basis
statement:
theorem quadratic_basis (e : M ≃+* N) (H B : Subfield M) (H' B' : Subfield N)
    (d : M) (d' : N) (hd : e d = d')
    (hH : ∀ x, x ∈ H ↔ e x ∈ H') (hB : ∀ x, x ∈ B ↔ e x ∈ B')
    (hne : d' ∉ H')
    (hquad : ∃ s p : H', d' ^ 2 - (s : N) * d' + (p : N) = 0)
    (hbasis : ∀ x : B', ∃! ab : H' × H',
      (ab.1 : N) + (ab.2 : N) * d' = (x : N)) :
    d ∉ H ∧
    (∃ s p : H, d ^ 2 - (s : M) * d + (p : M) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x : B, ∃! ab : H × H,
      (ab.1 : M) + (ab.2 : M) * d = (x : M))
